Raid: Captain-General Lainedhel of Ost Ringdyr

Attempts to weaken the enemy forces are proving fruitful, and the keep east of Tírith Rhaw, where the Elf Captain-General Lainedhel rules, is the target of assault. You are charged with organizing a war-band to assault Ost Ringdyr in an effort to slaughter the lord of the keep.
'Do not test me, ${PLAYER}. Seek the Captain-General of Ost Ringdyr, and do not return to me until he is dead!'

Ost Ringdyr is far to east beyond the Hoardale River and Tírith Rhaw.
Task-master Krul directed you to make your way to Ost Ringdyr to slaughter the lord of the keep.

Task-master Krul is at Gramsfoot.
After storming the walls of Ost Ringdyr, you fought through the enemy and defeated the leader of the keep. You should return to Task-master Krul with news of his defeat.
Poisoned the Hoardale!
The waterfall here looks ripe for the poison

'My time is better spent speaking to something with a spine. You'll likely wilt as a flower in the face of the dangers in this land, whelp! Still... you stand before me. Perhaps I should order you to cower and wait to be given a task.
'Very well. I shall quicken your death or return you to the slave pits in Carn Dûm, ${RACE}. Take this barrel. It is filled with poison from the spider-keepers of Angmar. Mordirith is specific in his orders. All that stand against this army must perish.
'We will poison the Hoardale River and slaughter all who are made weak by the poison. Take the barrel to the waterfall that overlooks Tol Ascarnen at the centre of the Ettenmoors and dump the poison into the river. Fail me, and I will flay your flesh open to let the rats consume your innards... but I will see that you live to feel the pain. Succeed... I will see you are not made to labour in the slave pits of Carn Dûm a while longer.'

'I am almost impressed with what you have done, ${RACE}. You might one day prove a fine conscript in this army. I shall take great satisfaction when I grind my boots on your corpse as we scale the walls of the târk cities!'
Poison the Hoardale River
Return to Uglash at Gramsfoot
Poisoning the Hoardale

Uglash provided you with a barrel of poison and a directive. Make your way to the waterfall overlooking the fortress Tol Ascarnen and empty the barrel into the water. With enough poison, you may force the enemy to leave the wood.

The source of the Hoardale is at the waterfall overlooking Tol Ascarnen.
Uglash sent you to poison the enemy's water source.

Uglash awaits your return at Gramsfoot.
You climbed to the top of the falls and poisoned the waters of the Hoardale. You should return to Uglash with the news.
Angmar claims Lugazag!

'${RACE}! Your brethren failed us. Lugazag, our tower here in the west, has fallen to the hands of a târk! We must make our way to the tower and slaughter the forces standing watch.
'Do this, and I might think more of you than a maggot, ripe for smashing. Fail me, and I will see you posted to the slave pits of Carn Dûm!'
Defeat Captain-General Harvestgain and claim Lugazag. You must not be defeated when the Captain-General falls
Raid: Captain-General Harvestgain
Captain-General Harvestgain is the leader of the Free Peoples at Lugazag.

'You best be back to tell me you've followed your orders, sluggard! Else I'll throttle you and put you on a cart bound for the muck beneath Mordirith's throne!
'Get out there and slaughter the Captain-General at Lugazag!'

Captain-General Harvestgain, a târk, leads the forces within Lugazag.
Soldier Súmtharb made it clear that the only objective is to strike down the enemy's leader.
Angmar claims Tírith Rhaw!

'You miserable cur! You lack ferocity or strength in your arms to face down a troll and ask me to find something for you to do? Best thing I can find for you involves mixing that pile of dung into that stew for the goblins!
'I've something you might yet prove yourself useful for. Far to the east, beyond the Hoardale River and Tol Ascarnen, there is a tower: Tírith Rhaw. We want to take the tower, but a force lead by the târk, Verdantine, stands in our way.
'If we gain that post, we'll give ourselves a position to launch more direct assaults on their camp and keep. Get some more of these worthless maggots about to help you take down the târk! Win this battle, and we'll feast on man-flesh in your honour! Fail... and we'll still feast on flesh and in your honour.'
Defeat Captain-General Verdantine and claim Tírith Rhaw. You must not be defeated when the Captain-General falls
Raid: Captain-General Verdantine

Târks control the tower on the eastern front of the battlefield in the Ettenmoors. The tower, Tírith Rhaw, is held by the Captain-General Verdantine and must be crushed for Angmar's Army to drive the enemy to the precipice of destruction.
'You maggot! Get to the east and Tírith Rhaw. Slaughter that târk! For the glory of Mordirith, Angmar, and Lugbúrz!'

Captain-General Verdantine is at Tírith Rhaw, far to the east and south, beyond the Hoardale River.
Soldier Dahámab directed you to gather others and lay siege to the tower Tírith Rhaw in an effort to kill the leader of the forces there.
Angmar claims Tol Ascarnen!

'Stand fast, worm. There is a task that needs doing, and your blood will stain the ground as well as any others.
'Where the Hoardale splits the battlefield, there is a keep. It was there that the Witch-king of Angmar stopped to give strength to the betrayers before returning to the Great Eye's service in Mordor!
'The keep is now in control of the enemy, and a dwarf stands as the head of the forces watching over the keep! You are charged with the recovery of the keep and return of it to the rightful holders!'
Defeat Captain-General Mákan and claim Tol Ascarnen. You must not be defeated when the Captain-General falls
Raid: Captain-General Mákan of Tol Ascarnen

The ancient keep Tol Ascarnen was once home to the Witch-king of Angmar as he returned to Mordor after facing the armies of Glorfindel in the north. The keep long lay in ruins, but still it holds majesty for the minions of Mordirith. You are tasked with assembling a force to liberate the holding from the dwarf who now calls the place home.

'Stop wasting time! Get your feeble innards out on the field of battle and earn your glory or die in the attempt!
'Go now, to Tol Ascarnen and face down the dwarf there!'

Tol Ascarnen sits on an island in the centre of the Hoardale River.
You have been tasked with finding and slaughtering the dwarf-leader who now stands in command of Tol Ascarnen.

'Look lively, you sack of filth! I've no time for chatter, only time for killing!
'The Snowreap-goblins in Arador's End sent scouts to us with news that Meldún, a dwarf who defended the Isendeep moved to Hoarhallow!
'Get down there and tear the dwarf's beard off his face before you gut him like a Nimwaith!'
Defeat Captain-General Meldún
Raid: Captain-General Meldún of Isendeep
You have defeated Captain-General Meldún
A dwarf patrols the streets of Hoarhallow, defending the rat-folk. End him.

'Get out there and slaughter that dwarf, you piss-ant! I'm not here to see you dally behind the safety of these walls! I will flay your hide and hang it from the walls of this fort if I must!
'To Hoarhallow... slaughter the dwarf Captain-General.'

Hoarhallow is south of Gramsfoot.
Soldier Dalgumthak directed you to Hoarhallow to kill the dwarf-lord in power there.
Angmar claims the Grimwood Lumber-yard!

'South across the river and east into the dark depths of the Grimwood, you will find a lumber-yard. We happened upon this yard a while ago, and it was devoid of any sign of enemy, but the small houses left behind were made by the rat-folk far to the south.
'The forest is ripe for harvesting, and the lumber-yard still functions. We must take this location back from the enemy, lest they continue to make their bows and arrows to garner strength for their number.
'We will also strike a blow against their leadership as an Elf stands against us at the lumber-yard.'
Defeat Captain-General Bordagor and claim the Grimwood Lumber-yard. You must not be defeated when the Captain-General falls
Raid: Captain-General Bordagor

The Grimwood forest covering most of Hithlad is home to a lumber-yard established by a race of small, tasty folk. The rat-folk dwell far away from the lumber-yard, but the enemy is there now. What is worse, an Elf stands at the head of the enemy's army.
'Make your way into the centre of the Grimwood and slaughter the Elf who leads the enemy at the Grimwood lumber-yard.'

The Grimwood Lumber-yard is at the heart of the Grimwood Forest.
Soldier Bagfra directed you to find your way to the Grimwood Lumber-yard and destroy the Elf-lord in charge of the enemy forces there.

'We welcome the arrival of our tall friends to Hoarhallow. With them, we hope to end the plight which has faced our people for a great long time.
'In the north, beyond the place where the Hoardale rises sharply by the Tall Folk fortress and bends to the east, at the crest of the hill, you will find Grothum where the goblins dwell. We wish to show them that we are not afraid of their ilk, and truly we are not. There are some of us willing to fight, but they have gone off to protect the wood and help the Tall Folk.
'If you are willing to help us, make your way north-east and defeat the goblins.'

'Such heroism! We are indebted to you, ${PLAYER}. We will not forget all that you have done for us.
'Please take this. The Tall Folk at Glân Vraig said that Quartermaster Ash there would assist all those that give us aid.'
Return to Ned Claybrick at Hoarhallow
Sundering the Snowreap

Goblins have been the main foe the Hobbits of Hoarhallow have contended with in all their years. They believe with the aid of the Tall Folk they can score a final victory against the Snowreap-goblins.
'You will find the goblins in their village, Grothum. It is far to the north and east in Arador's End.'

Snowreap-goblins inhabit Grothum, a village they established east of the Isendeep Mine in Arador's End.
Ned Claybrick asked you to assail the goblins in their home to deter them from future raids on Hoarhallow.

Ned Claybrick awaits your return at Hoarhallow, south and west of Grothum.
You found the Snowreap-goblins in Grothum and defeated them at their village. You should return to Ned Claybrick with the news.
Defeated Darktide-wolves (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, good ${RACE}. It is so nice to see friendly faces about, and at such a difficult time, too. If you have a moment, I could put on some tea and offer you a nice hearth to warm yourself near, or I could make an offer to you that we have been told you might find interest in.
'Tall folk are helping us as these battles rage about us. Terrible things are happening all around our village. People go missing now and again. We know that the forces north of us are a great evil, but they stirred the Darktide-wolves of the Grimwood into a terrible state.
'If you would... go into the wood, west and east of here, and kill some of the wolves. They are proving a danger to us all, and it is only a short matter of time before they attack our village.'

'Oh, it seems that the Big Folk are right! You are a true help to us here in Hoarhallow. They said that there would be people of all kinds to help us here, and I am pleased to see that they were right.
'It is hard to know who to trust these days. Here, they told us to give these out to those deserving of our thanks, and you, ${PLAYER}, are certainly deserving.
'They mentioned a man too, Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig -- a silly name for a place if you ask me. I think it lies far to the east of here.'
Defeat Darktide-wolves (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Return to Emerald Twospade at Hoarhallow
Wolves at Our Walls

Hoarhallow has always been in a difficult position. Being a village of hobbits in a place so filled with corruption and death is difficult, but these hobbits had lived in quiet obscurity until the Ongbúrz poured through the mountains north of their home. With the arrival of evil came new threats as the foes surrounding the village suddenly became aware of their presence.

'You will find the Darktide-wolves all throughout the Grimwood, east of our village, and west in the hills and valleys of the Steps of Gram. They are not too good at hiding, and they smell dreadful.
'Find them and kill them so they may prove less a threat to people here.'

Wolves can be found east and west of Hoarhallow, scattered throughout Hithlad and into the hills of the Steps of Gram.
Emerald Twospade explained that the wolves of the Ettenmoors have long been the true threat against the Little Folk of Hoarhallow. She enlisted your aid in destroying the creatures and lessening their threat.

Emerald Twospade is in Hoarhallow.
You scoured through the Grimwood and slew a large number of the Darktide-wolves. You should return to Emerald Twospade with the news.
Collected Wintersebb-fangs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'One cannot muster pride in such a time, ${RACE}, and I know that I shall question why I ask this when this war is done, but times are hard, and we need supplies.
'To the north and east of here there are drakes that soar the skies, stalk the caverns of the Isendeep, and perch on the outcroppings of the Misty Mountains. Their teeth can be fashioned well and made into arrowheads. We're low on ore and most we collect is meant for the forge at Tol Ascarnen.
'I swallow my pride to ask you to collect fangs for me. Seek the drakes -- do not go alone -- and return to me with their teeth, so I may assist those here who man the walls.'

'I'll not forget this in all my days, ${PLAYER}. We shall have arrows to spare now that you have given us these. Now to the next task of polishing and sharpening these into arrow heads.
'If you find yourself back in Glân Vraig, present this to Quartermaster Ash. She will see that you are treated well for your efforts here.'
'You will find the drakes I speak of in Arador's End. The Hobbits of Hoarhallow called them Wintersebb because they fly from the part of the mountains where the winter withdraws first each year.'
Speak with Lieutenant Sturla at Lugazag
Collect Wintersebb-fangs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Fangs for Arrows
Removed so far from the fortresses of Ost Ringdyr and Glân Vraig, Lieutenant Sturla asks you to undertake a dangerous mission for a deadly weapon.

Drakes can be found in Arador's End to the north and east of Lugazag.
Lieutenant Sturla asked you to retrieve drake fangs to assist in the crafting of arrows for the war effort and reinforcement of Lugazag.
Collected untreated leather-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Our foothold here is tenuous, ${PLAYER}. Driving the forces of Angmar from the tower was only the beginning, but their siege will not relent. Many were injured and much of our arms and armour has been terribly damaged.
'I have been ordered to assist in the collection of much needed resources to aid in the rearming process.
'You should be able to find leather to service our needs from any of the more natural creatures strewn throughout the Ettenmoors. Collect them and return them to me, and I will see that you are rewarded for your efforts.'

'I care not to know where these were gathered. It is bad enough we cannot send for aid at Rivendell. War, ${PLAYER}, makes us all do things we shall regret. Be safe as you travel through this marred and dangerous land.
'You may visit Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig for further rewards. Thank you.'
'Seek hides from the wild beasts of the Ettenmoors. The battle here is harsh, we cannot be too particular in what we accept.'
Speak with Sergeant-at-Arms Ambeng at Lugazag
Collect untreated leather-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Patching the Holes
As the battle in the Ettenmoors rages, the Free Peoples struggle to keep up their armour and weaponry for the siege.

Wild beasts with strong hides roam the Ettenmoors. The leather made from their hides will be useful to the war effort.
Sergeant-at-Arms Ambeng asked you to seek out untreated leather from the wild beasts throughout the Ettenmoors.
Collected Sun-touched tailfeathers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Your presence in my wood disturbs me, but not so much as the bearers of light, ${RACE}.
'My brood grows weak and is culled further by the enemy, and I seek my revenge. My first thought must be for my children, and so I task you with this:
'Eagles from the north join with your enemy and their lords have long sought to end my reign. Bring me proof of their destruction by way of their feathers, and I shall lend you my strength against the enemy.'
'Yes. This will do. The talons of the enemy will no longer harm my children. Let us march forwards and give them a lesson they will not soon forget!'
'Pluck the eagles clean. Return their plumes and I shall come with you against the enemy.'
Return the feathers to Gorgoris
Collect Sun-touched tailfeathers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Gorgoris the Gorger
Gorgoris, the ancient brood-mother of the Grimfang, will assist you in claiming the Grimwood Lumber-yard, if you help her defend her brood.

Eagles can be found throughout the Ettenmoors.
Gorgoris wishes to know that the threat against her brood is diminished before she enters the fight against the enemy. She asked you to slay the eagles and bring her their feathers as proof of the deed.
Collected hobbit-feet (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected legs of Men (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected Elf-ears (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected dwarf-beard (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'I've no time for chatter or chittering. Listen well, as I've a temper built only for battle and I will not tolerate failure.
'I need proof that you are worthy of fighting along my side, ${PLAYER}. You are a lowly worm to me, and without proof, I will not assist you... my strength and standing are not for risking on such pitiful slugs like you.
'Bring me proof that you are a true combatant in the service of Mordirith, Angmar, and Lugbúrz, and I will join your assault against the enemy!'

'Let nothing ill be spoken of you this day, ${PLAYER}. I shall heed your call and storm the castle with you.
'We shall rise for the glory of Angmar!
'We shall rise for the favour of Lugbúrz!
'We shall die to see that Mordirith's Army does not fail!
'Come on, lads! Let us have fun storming the castle!'
'Get me what I need you worthless wretch. I will not fight alongside sluggards and maggots.'
Return the items to Tyrant Uzulthrang
Collect hobbit-feet (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect legs of Men (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect Elf-ears (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect dwarf-beards (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Storming the Castle!
Tyrant Uzulthrang is here for battle and only battle. Stationed outside of Tol Ascarnen, the Tyrant pledges that he will fight against the enemy if you prove that you are worthy of his notice.
Tyrant Uzulthrang told you to assemble proof of your deeds, then and only then will he assist you in destroying the fools within Tol Ascarnen. He did not, however, tell you what proof he requires.
Collected Grimwood-heartwood (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Not that I've reason to explain myself, you worthless wretch, but I'm sending you into dangerous climes that I fear you will not return from, and I'd rather cover myself first.
'Within this wood are trees that walk. Terrible things that need death more than the little folk east of here... only the tree things aren't good eating. Now listen well, cur.
'I've need of the heartwood from these trees for the priestesses in Angmar. I'll earn favour from them, and you in turn will earn favour from the Krahjarn. This makes things right all around, and if you do well enough, I will look to you in the future. What do you say?'

'The priestesses in the North will reward me well for these, and I will share in the strength that I gain, ${PLAYER}.
'I will speak your name to the Krahjarn leaders. They will know you well.'
'What are you waiting for, a spoon? Go carve out those trees' hearts!'
Return to Chieftain Torbok at the Grimwood Lumber-camp
Collect Grimwood-heartwood (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Carving Out Hearts
The Angmarim within the city of Carn Dûm have a desire for the heartwood cut from the centre of the Leafcull-trees within the Grimwood. He has offered you a reward for collecting the heartwood.

Grimwood-heartwood can be found on the Leafcull-trees, though you may possibly find it in the fallen logs as well.
Chieftain Torbok directed you to recover and return Grimwood-heartwood to him.
Collected Grimwood-roots (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Maggot! Your role in this war is clear. You do as the Krahjarn say!
'In the wood are saplings. These saplings and some of the fallen timber might have long roots attached to them. We need roots from the Grimwood to tie the posts together.
'We need this place in perfect repair for when the enemy returns. If you prefer something more martial, you might find the wood crawling with creatures that have roots as well! Get out there!'
'These will do, but you took longer than I would have liked, worm! Make your way through these woods faster in the future, or I'll do some culling of my own.'
'Repairs need to be made, maggot! You'll aide us, or I will gut you. It is that simple. Get the lashings we need.'
Return to Chieftain Torbok at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Collect Grimwood-roots (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Lashing the Walls
Binding the walls at the lumber-yard requires roots to be used as lashings.

Roots can be found upon the downed trees throughout the Grimwood and the saplings that sprout from the ground. You might also find them on the Leafcull-trees.
Chieftain Torbok wants you to get lashings for the walls at the Grimwood Lumber-yard.
Collected Grimwood-logs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected Isendeep-ore (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'I look about me and know that this wood is corrupt, and still the life that dwells here pains me. We are fighting a war and each day we gain or lose ground, and yet life still teems here! I have learned hatred, ${PLAYER}. I have learned to slaughter and destroy and in this wood, where corruption has so long held sway, I am not at peace.
'We need more weapons. We need more wood to fire the furnaces at Dol Dínen and within Carn Dûm. We need molten metal to forge our blades!
'Tear down this forest, scour the land in the north. Bring me fire, bring me molten metal to make the weapons this war so desperately needs!'

'Fuel for the fires and metal for the blades. This war will not end until we fill the land. We shall stand atop a heap of corpses as high as the central spire of Carn Dûm, ${PLAYER}.
'Then shall the Great Eye see that we are his greatest servants! Then shall Mordirith and his servants kneel to the Uruk!'

'Ore and fire, flame and metal. They will twist on the forge and build the weapons to drive into the hearts of our enemy! Metal in the north and wood in the south. Rape the land, steal all it offers, and return it here.'
Return to Chieftain Torbok at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Collect Grimwood-logs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect Isendeep-ore (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Weapons of War
To wage a war, one needs weapons. To sustain a war-machine, one needs the items to drive the war-machine.

Wood can be found in the Grimwood Forest, and metal can be found in the Isendeep Mine.
Chieftain Torbok directed you to support the war effort by stripping the mines and forest bare.
Collected Grimwood-logs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Big log.
'You get.
'Me fix.'

'You give me log.
'Me happy.
'Me do work.'
'Get log... or me smash!'
Return to Taskmaster Ghamp at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Collect Grimwood-logs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Big Stuff
Taskmaster Ghamp, the troll stationed at the Grimwood Lumber-yard, made mention of \qbig log\q. You surmise that he needs large logs to repair the walls encircling the camp.

Find Grimwood-logs from felled trees or carve them from the Leafcull-trees in the area.
Taskmaster Ghamp communicated in his own way that he needs large logs to fix the walls at the Grimwood Lumber-yard.
Collected Grimwood-kindling (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Not log.
'Big sticks.
'You get!'
'Sticks used to fix things.'
'You no have sticks.'
Return to Taskmaster Ghamp at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Collect Grimwood-kindling (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Easy Pickings
Taskmaster Ghamp offered you a reward to find sticks not as big as logs. This likely means smaller-sized wood, like the kindling found throughout the Grimwood.

Grimwood-kindling can be found throughout the Grimwood area, from fallen timber. You might also find it on the Leafcull-trees in the wood.
Taskmaster Ghamp, in his own way, directed you to get Grimwood-kindling for repairs at the lumber-yard.

'A moment, ${PLAYER}. I am troubled by this wood -- not surprising given the corruption long seeping into the world -- but there is something more. Since our arrival, I have felt a sense of encroaching dread.
'To the west, there are a host of spiders stalking through the woods. I believe that the brood-mother may have returned to their home.
'If this is true, we must move at once to destroy her, lest Angmar's army convinces her to join the battle against us.'

'With Gorgoris defeated, the brood will not be drawn into the battle against us. We may be able to stand against this foe for some time now.
'Take this with my thanks and seek out Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig.'
Speak with First Marshal Núrdram at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Raid: Culling the Brood
Within the depths of the Grimwood, beneath a great stone shelter west of the Grimwood Lumber-yard is the lair of a terrifying spider, Gorgoris. She is a terrible threat to the Free Peoples.
'Seek out the brood-queen west of our camp and destroy her before Angmar's army draws her into the battle against us.'

Gorgoris, the brood-queen of the Grimfang, dwells somewhere within the Grimwood forest in Hithlad.
First Marshal Núrdram asked you to find the brood-queen of the Grimfang and destroy her.

First Marshal Núrdram awaits your return within the Grimwood Lumber-yard.
You found and destroyed Gorgoris, the Grimfang brood-queen.
Collected Grimwood-branches (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, ${CLASS}. It is good to see the faces of so many willing to aid in this battle. As you know, we are an island in this dangerous land. We have no true supply lines and must rely on our own number to satisfy the many needs this war-host commands.
'At the moment, we are in need of arrow-shafts. Scattered throughout this wood, and perhaps on the vile and corrupted Leafcull-trees, you will find small branches. Some, though certainly not all, of the branches will suffice, and we will offer you rewards for your assistance.
'Seek the wood throughout the Grimwood and Hithlad.'

'At a cursory glance it appears that many of these will make fine arrow shafts. You are due a reward, and I am an Elf of my word. Take this with my thanks.
'Should you find yourself with several of these, deliver them to Quartermaster Ash.'
'You will need to scour the Grimwood, within the bounds of Hithlad, and perhaps face down the corrupted Leafcull to obtain the shafts I require.'
Return to First Marshal Núrdram at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Collect Grimwood-branches (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Shafts for Arrows
Arrows are a commodity that will eventually run out and while bone and metal can be used to fashion the arrow-heads, only the straightest of branches can be used for the shaft.

Small branches can be found scattered on the ground and on the Leafcull-trees throughout the Grimwood.
First Marshal Núrdram asked you to search along the Grimwood and Hithlad for small branches that might be turned into arrowshafts.

'In the north, at the edge of the Mountains of Angmar, there are drakes the Hobbits of Hoarhallow call Wintersebb. So named for their trek down the mountain when the winter breaks and the Hoardale flows strong again.
'These drakes have become active since the arrival of the Free Peoples, and often they hamper our efforts to mine the Isendeep. We are in need of help culling their number to ensure that our efforts there go smoothly.
'If you are willing, gather allies and make your way north to confront the Wintersebb brood.'

'A great victory is earned this day, and it is by your hand that it has been gained. You have proven your worth to the Free Peoples and deserve this reward for your efforts.
'Should you wish to claim your ultimate prize, seek out Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig.
'You have earned your honour well, ${PLAYER}.'
Return to Lieutenant Swithulf at the Grimwood Lumber Camp
End of the Wintersebb
Far to the north, where the Isendeep Mine runs beneath the shadow of the Mountains of Angmar, a brood of drakes threatens the workers within the mine.

'You will find the Wintersebb-drakes north of here in the land called Arador's end. Seek out and destroy the drakes and drakelings you find there. A word of caution, friend: you will not want to venture there alone.'

Wintersebb-drakes can be found north in the area of Arador's End.
Lieutenant Swithulf directed you to make your way north with others in search of a way to destroy the Wintersebb-drakes.

Lieutenant Swithulf awaits your return at the Grimwood Lumber-yard.
Climbing high into the foothills of the Mountains of Angmar in Arador's end, you faced down many foes from the Wintersebb-brood and emerged to collect your reward.
Collected Grimwood-logs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected unrefined Isendeep-ore (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'The battle goes poorly, if you ask me, ${CLASS}. We drive the Enemy back, and then they return to run us out. All the while, our resources dwindle, while the Enemy continues to garner strength.
'We are in dire need of replenishing our supplies for the effort, and that is why I need your help. To the north there is a mine where our dwarf-allies delve when the Snowreap-goblins are not within the caverns. There are stores there of unrefined ore. We can refine the ore and build axes, swords, and hammers... but first we need the ore.
'Ore alone, however, will not solidify the war effort. There are thicker logs, some already hewn to the ground, scattered throughout the Grimwood and others still may be obtained from the deadly, walking Leafcull-trees. If you mean to aid us, gather logs and ore for me and bring them back so I may continue to fuel our efforts.'

'You are to be commended for your efforts, ${PLAYER}. This was a difficult undertaking, and you have performed it well. Take this with my thanks and the thanks of the Free Peoples.
'Should you desire to exchange the token, seek Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig.'

'Seek the ore in the north within the confines of the Isendeep Mine or on the bodies of the Snowreap-goblins. In the Grimwood, search amongst the fallen logs or the fallen bodies of the Leafcull-trees.'
Return to Lieutenant Swithulf at the Grimwood Lumber-yard
Collect Grimwood-logs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect unrefined Isendeep-ore (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Heft and Haft
Weapons are difficult to come by in war-time as many are shattered as the sides of battle clash.

Ore can be found on the Snowreap-goblins or in the depths of the Isendeep. Logs can be found on Leafcull-trees or scattered on the ground within the Grimwood.
Lieutenant Swithulf directed you to collect the ore and wood he needs and return to him at the Grimwood Lumber-yard.
Collected Elf-ears (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Kill Elves.
'Take ears.
'Food!'
'Taste good. Me eat now. Leave.'
'Get ears... Elf-ears... now!'
Return to Taskmaster Raulik at Tol Ascarnen
Collect Elf-ears (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Taste of Elf
At Tol Ascarnen, Taskmaster Raulik explained in his limited capacity that he desired to feast upon Elf-ears.

Elves can be found within the Ettenmoors.
Taskmaster Raulik attempted to communicate that he wishes you to find Elves from which to cultivate their ears... a rare delicacy.
Collected norbog-chitin (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Listen well, maggot. I'm working on getting protection on the vermin around us. Many think my idea foolish, but you've no opinion worth hearing... so you'll do as I say.
'Get the chitin from the little bugs hereabouts and return it to me so I can make it into suitable armour for Wargs and spiders.'

'We shall soon know if the chitin is worth crafting into armour for the vermin. Should this work, perhaps I can convince the War-tyrant to use them in our battle. You have earned a good word from me, ${PLAYER}.'
'Are you still standing about? I've no chitin to test my prowess with, worm. Get it! Now!'
Return to Quartermaster Apsduf
Collect norbog-chitin (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Armour for the Lessers

Quartermaster Apsduf believes that the lesser creatures in Angmar's army -- spiders and Wargs -- need armour and thinks that he can assist them by crafting armour from the chitin of the Neekerbreekers nearby.

Nerbyg, also called Neekerbreekers, dwell near the river-banks.
Quartermaster Apsduf directed you to collect chitin to craft the armour he intends for the Wargs and spiders.
Collected Thistledown-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'${RACE}, listen here. As the battle rages about us, we must remember that we serve the glory of the Great Eye and his servant Mordirith in the Army of Angmar. There is no better way to show our prowess in battle than to fly our standards when we take these fortresses!
'Our enemy tears down our flags and destroys them. Materials are hard to find in this desolate land, so we must hunt for the materials we need. Scattered throughout the land here, there are massive aurochs. Their hides are sizeable and can easily be used to make the flags we need.
'Hunt them in packs and skin them for their hides.'

'These hides will suffice. With them we shall rebuild the flags torn and burned by the enemy. These fields will run red with their blood, and soon the air will burn, and these flags shall fly throughout all lands!
'For the glory of Angmar, Mordirith, and Lugbúrz!'
'Retrieve those hides, maggot! We can't claim our land without flags!'
Return to Quartermaster Apsduf at Tol Ascarnen
Collect Thistledown-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Fly the Flags

Angmar's command of the Ettenmoors is unquestioned, but as the battle rages and the strongholds which the enemy and your army clash over change hands, the flags that show your dominance are taken and destroyed. You must assist the war-host by supplying your quartermasters with the necessary materials.

Thistledown aurochs can be found throughout the Ettenmoors.
Quartermaster Apsduf sent you into the wild to collect the hides of the mighty Thistledown aurochs. Their hides will be made into flags for Angmar's army.
Collected norbog-gizzards (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected norbog-meat (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'${RACE}, you want to eat, and though it pains me to waste even the lowliest gruel on a pathetic thing like yourself, I've orders to keep you well fed. You'll not taste the tribute collected for the tyrant, nor the foods we eat.
'Your meal comes from the bugs outside these walls. If you don't like it, you can take the chance that a wandering giant or drake doesn't gobble up the goblins or couriers from Dâr-gazag. Oh, we've got food from the rat-folk too... but that is for the Krahjarn, you lowly little beast.
'You'll eat what you get and nothing more. Be thankful I'll prepare it for you! Catch your meal and bring it back here!'

'Mash this together, boil it well, and your dinner will be ready.
'Now is not time for eating, worm.'
'If you're not hungry, I'll watch you rot. I can cover myself fairly well, you little maggot. If you want your nerves strong, you'll get the meat for which I ask.'
Return to Quartermaster Apsduf at Tol Ascarnen
Collect norbog-gizzards (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect slabs of norbog-meat (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Grumbling and Rumbling

Choice food, meat from Men and the rat-folk, goes to the Krahjarn. Quartermaster Apsduf realizes that you need to eat as well, and since the mash cooked at Dâr-gazag doesn't always reach Tol Ascarnen, he needs help getting dinner for your rumbling bellies.

Nerbyg can be found along the banks of the Hoardale River surrounding Tol Ascarnen.
Collect the gizzards and meat from the nerbyg to give to Apsduf for your nightly gruel.
Collected legs of Men (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Pay attention to everything I say, wretch, else I'll stretch your hide from the west bridge of this island to the east bridge. Our leader, Tyrant Trintrû, is deserving of our praise and our tribute. Time for you to pay your tribute, dog.
'The one thing, above all else, that Tyrant Trintrû desires is Man-flesh. So you will oblige him. You will go into the wild, find the Men at their holdings or wandering through the wood, ripe for picking, and you will cut their legs from their bodies.
'Bring their legs back to me, and I will see that the Tyrant knows you have paid him proper tribute! Go now, worm!'
'For the glory of Angmar, Mordirith, and the service of Lugburz! You serve your masters well, cur!'
'You worthless, scum! I gave you an order to fetch Man-flesh, and you come before me without all that you need! Back into the fight and don't return to me until you have collected enough Man-flesh!'
Return to Quartermaster Apsduf at Tol Ascarnen
Collect legs of Men (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Tribute to the Tyrant
Tyrant Trintrû at Tol Ascarnen is deserving of praise and tribute. The tribute which the tyrant desires most is the flesh of Men.

Men can be found throughout the Ettenmoors.
Quartermaster Apsduf ordered you to gather Man-flesh as tribute to the Tyrant at Tol Ascarnen.
Collected norbog-gizzards (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected slabs of norbog meat (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Listen well, ${CLASS}. We're in a battle that will rage for a good long time, and we're in need of supplies. Though the land will give up some edible meats, much of what is here is useless.
'Now, food stores are raided often, and we've lost a good portion of our supplies. We need to be mindful of the future and think about ways that we can increase our existing food sources. This might turn your stomach some -- it does mine -- but there are nerbyg surrounding this fortress, and though they might seem a might unsavoury, we've found that cooked long enough and with enough spice, they can make a good source of food... in a pinch.
'Round up a bundle of their gizzards and meat, and I'll reward you for what you bring.'

'Terrible sort of thing to do, but we're not here to be making a comely home. We are in a war, ${CLASS}. War makes you do things you would ought not normally do.
'You've earned this, ${PLAYER}. Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig is collecting these for greater rewards.'
'Bring me the gizzards and meat from the nerbyg within the Hoardale.'
Return to Lieutenant Solvi at Tol Ascarnen
Collect norbog-gizzards (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect slabs of norbog meat (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Emergency Rations
Lieutenant Solvi asked that you assist him in collecting emergency rations for the fortress.

There are nerbyg all around Tol Ascarnen. Lieutenant Solvi is at Tol Ascarnen.
Lieutenant Solvi awaits your return with the meat and gizzards from the nerbyg.
Collected draughts of Hoarhallow-ale (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Listen here. Captain-General Makán looks out for the Free Peoples as best he can, and that's why he has me working on restocking food and ale.
'Hoarhallow, that little village of hobbits to the south-west, makes the finest ale in the region -- well, the only ale in the region. Slightly bitter to appeal to the taste of dwarves and Men, with a sweet finish that the Elves desire.
'Raiders from the forces of Angmar have looted so much of the ale that there is not enough left to go around. Find some Hoarhallow-ale and make your way back to me, and I will see you suitably rewarded.'

'Ah yes! A great many of the draughts, indeed! This'll warm our bones on long nights looking out over the walls of this fort.
'You've earned this, ${PLAYER}. Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig is collecting these for greater rewards.'
'I'll need a goodly number of draughts before I can cede a token of valour to you, ${CLASS}. You'd best get out there and find them.'
Return to Lieutenant Solvi at Tol Ascarnen
Collect draughts of Hoarhallow-ale (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Liquid Courage

Captain-General Mákan does his best to assist the morale of the troops stationed at Tol Ascarnen. The relentless battle takes its toll on a being over time, and ale is the best way to keep the Free Peoples prepared.

You may be able to find some in Hoarhallow itself, but it will likely be costly. You may even find the draughts stored at Grothum and Dâr-gazag.
Lieutenant Solvi asked you to find and recover draughts of Hoarhallow-ale.
Collected food-sacks (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Ho there, ${CLASS}, you look like the sort who might help me fix some of the problems we found soon as we took this fortress. We and the Orcs fight here often, and we sometimes get beat back from within only to return later.
'During the last siege, it seemed like a score of Orcs stormed over me and got to our stores. We lost a good number of supplies in that assault, and we need to get them back. I've heard tell that the Orcs, trolls, and even the goblins are walking about with the food-sacks on their person. Hobbits need it too, those poor folk down the river a pinch.
'Slaughter the Orcs in the area and look for the food-sacks. I've heard tell you can find mountains of the stolen food at their camp, Dâr-gazag, in the west or maybe some up north near the goblin's village of Grothum.'

'I may seem a bit harsh, ${PLAYER}, that is true. But I want to see that we do what must be done to see this battle won. You helped us more than you know, and for that, I am grateful.
'Speak with Quartermaster Ash to learn of the importance of these tokens.'
'You've been given an order, and I expect you to follow it! Get out there and get that food back to us!'
Return to Lieutenant Solvi at Tol Ascarnen
Collect food-sacks (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Thieving Orcs

West of Tol Ascarnen, across the Hoardale River, the Orcs make their main keep. It is here that Lieutenant Solvi believes the Orcs have stolen precious food stores moved into Tol Ascarnen during the initial push by the Free Peoples, and he wants them back.

Food-sacks might be found on the Orcs, trolls, and goblins in the Ettenmoors.
Lieutenant Solvi advised you to search Grothum and Dâr-gazag for more plentiful amounts of the food-sacks, but also said that the Ongbúrz and Snowreap may have some on their persons.
Defeated Cragstone-spiders (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Long have the Elves of Mirkwood spoken of spiders with great intelligence, but until I came here, I did not believe such tales.
'Now, we see them amongst the rank and file of the Enemy. They are terrible, cruel, and calculating. In the west, along the moors beneath Mount Gram, the Cragstone-spiders lair and breed.
'I challenge you, ${PLAYER}, to seek out the beasts in the crags and slaughter them. That will hopefully alleviate the plight facing our warriors who head into the rocky Steps of Gram.'

'A good number of the spiders are gone, but the brood is plentiful, and it will not be long before they replenish their numbers and must be culled again.
'For all that you have done, I offer you this, ${PLAYER}. Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig will exchange these for something more suitable.'
Defeat Cragstone-spiders (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Return to Quartermaster Cynwiss at Tol Ascarnen
Crawlers of the Crags
Efficient hunters within the crags of the Steps of Gram, the Cragstone-spiders allied themselves with the Enemy, stalk the hobbits at Hoarhallow, and drive out the Free Peoples from the west.
'Search among the moors west of Tol Ascarnen, beyond Lugazag, for the Cragstone-spiders. Slay as many as you can and then return to me.'

The Cragstone-spiders can be found in the crags west of Tol Ascarnen, beyond the tower Lugazag in the shadow of Dâr-gazag.
Quartermaster Cynwiss asked you to defeat the Cragstone-spiders in the moors of the Steps of Gram.

Quartermast Cynwiss awaits your return at Tol Ascarnen.
You made your way into the moors in the Steps of Gram and slaughtered a host of the Cragstone-spiders.
Collected Thistledown-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, ${CLASS}. No doubt you are here to assist us in seeing that the flags over our positions here in the Ettenmoors continue to fly. There are a few ways that you can contribute to that cause.
'First, continue your battle against the forces of the Enemy... this will ensure that we continue to drive the front forward. Second, assist me in acquiring the materials to make new flags. As each of our strongholds is overrun -- and it does happen, despite our best efforts -- we lose munitions and our flags. The material cost and shipment of new ones would take too long, so artisans amongst us are handling the craftwork, but we still need to gather the materials.
'We are only using the hide of the Thistledown-aurochs as they are the creatures least corrupted in these lands. If you are willing, help us collect their hides and return them to me.'

'You return with all that I asked for, ${PLAYER}. This may not seem as important as defeating the Enemy on a field of battle, yet knowing that your standard still waves above a fortress can instill fear into the hearts of the foe and inspire those under your command.
'Take this... Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig will reward you well.'
'I need more hides. It will take time to properly prepare them for the artisans.'
Return to Quartermaster Cynwiss at Tol Ascarnen
Collect Thistledown-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Flags of The Free Peoples
Flying the flags of the Free Peoples at Tol Ascarnen gives hope to those entrenched in the battle. Each time the fortress is taken, the flags are destroyed by the Enemy and they must be remade.

Thistledown-aurochs can be found throughout the Ettenmoors.
Quartermaster Cynwiss asked you to assist her in collecting hides to craft the flags of the Free Peoples in the Ettenmoors.
Defeated Snowreap-trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Defeated Coldeve-trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'We know that there are trolls scattered throughout the north and certainly in service to Angmar. What we did not expect was the number of the trolls in service to the Snowreap-goblins, and worse, the Coldeve that roam the Ettenmoors.
'We need to do something about these beasts, lest they become a greater threat to us over time. Gather a fellowship of like-minded people and seek a way to destroy these deadly beasts.'

'Knowing that their number has been culled gives me reason to pause and reflect on my youth. I was once a brazen youth willing to face down such foes without concern. I envy the wild nature you possess, ${PLAYER}. It suits you well and is needed as this battle begins to progress.
'Here, take this, you should seek out Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig to claim your true prize.'
Defeat Snowreap-trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Defeat Coldeve-trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Return to Lieutenant Osur at the Isendeep Mine
Reaping the Snow and Cold

The Ettenmoors is home to many terrifying beasts, but the most frightening are the trolls. It is from here that the trolls pushed to infest the Trollshaws, and still many stalk through the wilds of the Ettenmoors.
'You'll likely find the Snowreap in areas where you would find the goblins. The Coldeve may be a bit harder to locate. They migrate all throughout the Ettenmoors, from what we have seen.'

Snowreap-trolls are likely to be found in the northern stretches of Arador's End, near the Isendeep Mine. You may also find Coldeve stone-trolls, but they have been known to wander the entirety of the Ettenmoors.
After speaking to Lieutenant Osur, you were enlisted to assist in destroying the Snowreap and Coldeve-trolls.

Lieutenant Osur awaits news of your success at the Isendeep Mine.
You found and slaughtered the Coldeve and Snowreap-trolls as directed to by Lieutenant Osur. Now you should return to him with the news.
Defeated Shadowmaw-wargs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'In the west, in the shadow of Mount Gram, a pack of Wargs with a vile and dark bite roams freely and stalks out towards our holdings. These Wargs, the Shadowmaw, are responsible for many attacks on our number.
'We must find a way to cull their number. If you are willing, travel west and cut them down. Strike a telling blow against this foe lest their danger grow over time.'

'While the battle rages there is no rest from the foes that we face, but for the moment we are spared. Take this reward, ${PLAYER}.
'In time, you will learn that these shall earn you great wealth. Seek out Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig to learn more.'
Defeat Shadowmaw-wargs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Return to Lieutenant Octa at the Isendeep Mine
Mouth of Shadow
In the crags to the west of the Isendeep, the Shadowmaw pack bolsters the forces of Angmar.
'You will find that the Shadowmaw are drawn to the Steps of Gram. Be cautious when travelling through that land. It teems with the forces of Angmar and is perpetually cast in shadow.'

The Shadowmaw stalk the Steps of Gram.
Lieutenant Octa at the Isendeep Mine asked you to reduce the threat posed by the Shadowmaw-wargs.

Lieutenant Octa is at the Isendeep Mine.
Lieutenant Octa will be pleased to learn that you have succeeded at destroying a good number of the Wargs in the Steps of Gram.

'Goblins will aid us in this place, and this is good. Mining is for such lowly races.
'It is the place of warriors, like you, to seize moments and become great! We are vulnerable -- I fear assault at the hands of the eagles who are not far from here.
'The greatest among them, Golloval, is a lord of the sky, and it falls to you and others to bring him at last to the ground!'

'A threat such as this will not last. I have word that even as he fell and you left him to rot, that the eagle-lord took to the sky again.
'He will return, but we have earned a reprieve by your will!'
Return to Taskmaster Bárzqhosh at the Isendeep Mine
Raid: Grounding Golloval

Taskmaster Bárzqhosh wants you to ensure that the threat posed by the eagles and their leader, Golloval, is diminshed. He has ordered you to gather a great number and assail the eagle-lord at his eyrie in Arador's End.
'Do not fail, or this mine will fall into the hands of the enemy, and you will suffer in the slave-pits of Carn Dûm.'

Golloval can be found south of the mine in an eagle-eyrie.
Taskmaster Bárzqhosh tasked you with finding and slaughtering the eagle, Golloval.

Taskmaster Bárzqhosh awaits your return outside the Isendeep Mine.
Golloval found his end at your will. You should return to Taskmaster Bárzqhosh with the news.
Collected Grimwood-kindling (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'The mine spills ore from every new scar we open in its walls, but the tools our slaves use grow weaker with every swing.
'There is a place, far to the south, where the wood is strong. Go there, to the Grimwood. Find healthy stocks of wood and bring them to us. They need only be better than roots. Some may call it kindling, but the wood will prove sturdy enough for our purposes.
'Make haste, ${RACE}. We must continue our assault and drive the enemy from this land!'

'We will go about refitting the tools now and see that the mine gives up ore at a faster pace. This shall fuel our war-machine, and we shall crush our opponents with ease.
'For the glory of Angmar! For the Great Eye!'
'Get a move on, sluggard. We need the ore within these walls!'
Return to Taskmaster Bárzqhosh at the Isendeep Mine
Collect Grimwood-kindling (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Tools for the Mine
Your war-host claims to have enough metal now that the mine is in-service and under your control, but the picks used by the goblins are dulled with time and the wood rots out from their hands.

Kindling can be found in the Grimwood.
Taskmaster Bárzqhosh tasked you with garnering enough wood to repair the picks used to pull ore from the Isendeep.
Collected Sun-touched tailfeathers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Me no likes eagles.
'Eagles go... on dead troll.
'You kill eagles, take feathers.
'Make me like you.'

'No more fouling dead troll... eagle-bird!'
The troll eats the feathers. Peculiar.
'Go get feathers! No more fly....'
Return to Taskmaster Izubuzri at the Isendeep Mine
Collect Sun-touched tailfeathers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Slaughtering Eagles
Taskmaster Izubuzri communicated that he wants proof that you killed many eagles. Apparently the eagles are too free with where they perch.

Eagles can be found throughout the Coldfells and in a small section of Arador's End to the south of the Isendeep Mine.
Taskmaster Izubuzri wants you to return eagle feathers to him to prove that you have slaughtered a good number of the birds.
Defeated Orc, Uruk, and troll-guards at Lugazag (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, friend ${RACE}. I urge you to listen and consider my words, for this battle is one that shall assist in deciding the fate of all who are threatened by the shadow growing over Middle-earth. To the west of this tower there is a place of evil. Within the walls once held by the Men of Rhudaur, corruption seethes and grows.
'A host of the Enemy awaits an assault from the Free Peoples that must be levied with swiftness, strength, and courage. The tower is called Lugazag, and I ask you to assist us in defeating the Enemy that guards the tower.
'You will likely need the assistance of others as they will fight to the death if need be. Find them and meet them, return to me when you have done as charged.'

'You have proven to be a ${RACE} of honour. You shall be rewarded and your tale shall be told amongst the forces here in the Ettenmoors.
'For all you have done to aid us, I salute you, ${PLAYER}.'
Defeat Orc, Uruk, and troll-guards at Lugazag (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Guards of Lugazag
Lugazag, the western tower in the Ettenmoors, is defended by a host of Orcs, Uruks, and trolls.

'I only wish to know that the guards near and within Lugazag are slain. Though the battle is fought on many fronts, I wish to liberate and seize this tower above all else. Return to me when the guards are defeated.'

Lugazag lies far to the west of Tírith Rhaw.
Sergeant-at-Arms Milbrethil instructed you to find and slay guards in the area of Lugazag.

Tírith Rhaw is far to the east of Lugazag.
Making your way across the Ettenmoors, you found and faced a host of the Ongbúrz defending the tower, Lugazag. You should return to Tírith Rhaw and inform Sergeant-at-Arms Milbrethil of your success against the guards near Lugazag.
Collected Morningthaw-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Stop looking at me that way. I've no fear! I've got my orders, and my orders are to pass along a message to you from the War-tyrant! The army is tired and cold. I've been dispatched here to see that we do something about this.
'I'm not going outside the safety of this tower! Too many of the enemy nearby for my liking! You go get the hides that I need, and I'll be sure to tell all others that you helped.
'Get hides from the bears around us. They are the most dangerous thing we face in these parts!'

'I shall be a hero! You have made me a hero!
'Ha! You pathetic beast! I will not honour my word. You are my slave, and I a hero!'
'Go get the hides, I can hear the bears even now. Don't carry any food near me, I don't want them to find me.'
Deliver the Morningthaw-hides to Soldier Fandmau
Collect Morningthaw-hides (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Bedding of Bears
Soldier Fandmau, stationed at Tírith Rhaw, ordered you to collect the hides of the Morningthaw-bears to use as bedding for the army.

Bears can be found around Tírith Rhaw.
Soldier Fandmau waits for you to return with the bear-hides he ordered you to collect.
Coldfells Army member slaughtered! (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Taking this tower puts us in harm's way, and the Free Peoples will not sit idly by while we are so close to their keep. We must slaughter them now and slaughter them quickly, lest they enter the tower and do us all in.
'Go quickly! Kill them!'

'Dead? Yes, dead. You did well. Perhaps we will survive a bit longer.
'Leave now. Please, keep watching the area.'
Slaughter members of the Coldfells Army (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Return to Soldier Fandmau at Tírith Rhaw
Flay the Free Peoples
Soldier Fandmau fears reprisal for the assault of Tírith Rhaw and wants you to attack the Free Peoples quickly before they retaliate.
'I don't smell the blood of innocents on you. Get out there and kill the enemy! Only then will I respect you enough to not see you as a worthless wretch!'

Defenders of the Free Peoples can be found throughout the Ettenmoors.
Soldier Fandmau directed you to slaughter the defenders loyal to the Free Peoples.

Soldier Fandmau is at Tírith Rhaw.
You found and slaughtered a good number of the enemy.
Collected fragments of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected shards of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected slabs of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Guarding this post makes me nervous. So close to the enemy and trolls bashing holes through the stone. We need to shore the walls here and fast.
'Get stone from the dead trolls throughout the Ettenmoors and return them to me. No stone is too small!'

'I'd build a wall if I could to keep the enemy from getting into our halls. We should be more defensible. Higher walls, larger tower... more trolls!!!
'You did well, ${PLAYER}. I will speak well of you for a time.'
'What is this? Coming back to me empty handed!? Sluggards like you are why we run the risk of assault from everywhere! Get out there and get me what I need.'
Return to Soldier Fandmau at Tírith Rhaw
Collect fragments of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect shards of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect slabs of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Stonewall Fandmau
Soldier Fandmau needs stone to repair the holes blasted through the walls of Tírith Rhaw and sent you to find the materials from the trolls caught in the sun.

Trolls that have been turned to stone by the sun are scattered throughout the Ettenmoors.
Soldier Fandmau tasked you with obtaining a fair number of large to small bits of troll-stone to repair the walls of Tírith Rhaw.
Collected sacks of food (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected fragments of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'I've been thinking of ways to keep the eagles away from this place. Their claws make me wince, and I'm not one to like blood.
'You're the perfect fool to test this theory with, or at least to be an accomplice to me. So you'll do as I say, or I'll call for the trolls.
'Shards of troll-stone, wrapped in foodstuff might fill the birds' bellies with so much weight that they can't fly anymore! I need you to get me little shards of troll-stone and some food to test the theory.'

'Ha! When next the eagles come to prey on us, we will feed them the stones and they will fall to the ground and die!
'If this fails... you will serve as a suitable reason for the failure!'

'You've done nothing, you worthless pile of festering dung! Have you been beaten so daft you cannot follow simple orders? Do you not understand the terror that will assail us from the skies? Go! Leave my sight, and do not return until you have redeemed yourself.'
Return to Soldier Fandmau at Tírith Rhaw
Collect sacks of food (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect fragments of troll-stone (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
I've Got a Theory
Soldier Fandmau believes that he can aid in ending the threat posed by the eagles from the north by feeding them troll-stone. How an Orc like this one became a leader is beyond you.

Troll-stone shards will likely be found from smaller or larger pieces of the trolls caught in the sunlight. Food can be found on the enemy or the rat-folk in Hoarhallow.
Soldier Fandmau needs some help proving out a theory he has.
Collected sun-touched tailfeathers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Feathers... good... crown.
'Get feathers... or smash you.'
'You get me feathers!'
'You get me feathers?'
Return to Taskmaster Núrsufum at Tírith Rhaw
Collect sun-touched tailfeathers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Feather for His Cap

Not all who rise to military prominence are capable of complete conversations. Trolls, known for their strength, sometimes manage small words. For instance, Taskmaster Núrsufum. Apparently, Taskmaster Núrsufum likes to place feathers in his helmet and wants you to go about getting the feathers he desires.

Sun-touched eagles are found throughout the Coldfells and sections of Arador's End.
Taskmaster Núrsufum wants you to get him tailfeathers for his helm.

'Big bear... head of gold... come... fight.
'You go stop.
'Now!'

'Good.
'Me no kill you.'
Return to Taskmaster Núrsufum
Goldhead Must Die

Trolls do not communicate well, as is proving true time and again. You think you were able to piece together a terrible truth from what Taskmaster Núrsufum tried to say. A bear named Goldhead may be aligned with the enemy, and if they act quickly enough, may assist the enemy against the tower.

'Smash bear!
'Now!'

Old Goldhead may be within a bear-den near Tírith Rhaw.
Taskmaster Núrsufum seems to have communicated that a great bear nearby named Goldhead may be allied with the enemy.

Taskmaster Núrsufum is at Tírith Rhaw.
You found and destroyed Old Goldhead. Now you should return to Taskmaster Núrsufum.
The Free People reclaim Tírith Rhaw!

'The Orcs proved strong enough to overwhelm our forces in Tírith Rhaw. Now a fell foe has taken control of the tower. We must muster our forces and drive them from that place at once.
'Gather a force together and make your way north into the Coldfells. Tírith Rhaw stands overlooking the valley to the west. You must enter and defeat the master of the Ongbúrz at this location.
'Seek out the Tyrant Barashish at Tírith Rhaw and defeat him. Fight with honour and return the tower to our control.'

'You did well, ${PLAYER}. We need to continue our efforts in driving these Orcs from the Ettenmoors. Take this and know that you are well-thanked for your efforts.
'Seek out Quartermaster Ash in Glân Vraig to retrieve your greatest rewards.'
Defeat Tyrant Barashish and reclaim Tírith Rhaw. You must not be defeated when the tyrant falls
Speak with Sergeant Hesten
Raid: Tyrant Barashish
A powerful Orc warrior, the Tyrant Barashish has taken command of Tírith Rhaw. Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten has enlisted your talents in removing the Orc from the tower.
'We must retake Tírith Rhaw. Make your way to the tower, north of this location, in the centre of the Coldfells. Defeat the Tyrant Barashish, then return to me.'

The Tyrant Barashish is at Tírith Rhaw, north of Glân Vraig, in the centre of the Coldfells.
Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten at Glân Vraig directed you to seek out and defeat the Orc Tyrant, Barashish who holds command at Tírith Rhaw.

Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten awaits your return at Glân Vraig.
You defeated the Tyrant Barashish to reclaim Tírith Rhaw. You should return to Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten with the news.
The Free People claim Lugazag!

'Lugazag is a tower claimed wholly by the Enemy. If we are to tame this battlefield and control it for the cause of the Free Peoples, we must overwhelm their position and defeat their leader.
'With the head of the tower removed their forces will sunder, and we shall win the day. Take heart and seek the aid of many.
'Journey to the west beneath the shadow of Mount Gram in the Steps of Gram and siege Lugazag. Drive within its heart and defeat the leader of the Ongbúrz there, the Tyrant Tharbil. Do this, and you will earn great honour.'
'You did well, ${PLAYER}. Take this with our thanks and seek out Quartermaster Ash here to lay claim to the rewards which await you.'
Defeat Tyrant Tharbil and claim Lugazag. You must not be defeated when the tyrant falls
Speak with Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten at Glân Vraig
Raid: Tyrant Tharbil
Lugazag, a tower far to the west of Glân Vraig, is held by the Ongbúrz Orc-tribe and commanded by the Tyrant Tharbil.
'We must defeat these curs. Make your way to the tower, north and west of Glân Vraig in the Steps of Gram, defeat the Tyrant Tharbil, and return to me.'

Lugazag looks east out over the Hoardale River.
Once Lugazag was a great tower, part of the Rhudauran kingdom. Now, in the corrupt lands of the Steps of Gram, the tower stands as a location controlled by the Ongbúrz tribe and their Tyrant, Tharbil. Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten at Glân Vraig directed you to seek out and defeat the Tyrant Tharbil who holds command at Lugazag.

Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten awaits your return at Glân Vraig.
You defeated Tyrant Tharbil with the help of others to reclaim Tírith Rhaw. You should return to Sergeant-at-Arms Hesten and tell him of your victory over Tharbil.
Tyrant Durgrat Slain

'We face an organized tribe of Orcs here, ${CLASS}. We will need the assistance of all capable peoples to defeat these foes.
'Scouts, reporting from the deepest parts of the front, have discovered that the leader of this war-host resides at Dâr-gazag, an encampment built on the ruins of an ancient Rhudauran fortress, far to the west of Ost Ringdyr.
'I am authorized to present you with much acclaim if you assist in defeating this war-master. Be cautious as the enemy is strong at this fortress. You will need a great number to overwhelm their forces and defeat the War-tyrant, Durgrat.'

'Durgrat's defeat is a great one, but he will return. His forces will not allow his defeat to influence them for long.
'We have earned a brief respite from their assaults thanks to you, ${PLAYER}, but we must not rest on these successes.'
Kill Tyrant Durgrat at Dâr-gazag. You must not be defeated when the tyrant falls
Speak with Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent at Glân Vraig
Raid: Tyrant Durgrat
A great leader of the Ongbúrz, Tyrant Durgrat, is holed up in Dâr-gazag, far to the west.
'You will find the War-tyrant in the upper reaches of Dâr-gazag. Make your way there and defeat him and his war-host. Return here when the deed is done.'

Dâr-gazag, built on the ruins of a Rhudauran citadel, lay far to the west of Ost Ringdyr, across the Hoardale River. Make your way to the fortress and defeat War-master Durgrat at this location.
Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent directed you to kill the Uruk-warmaster Durgrat at Dâr-gazag.

Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent awaits your return at Glân Vraig.
Facing down the Enemy, you destroyed the War-master at Dâr-gazag. You should return to Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent with the news.
The Free People reclaim Tol Ascarnen!

'Captain-General Mákan wishes to retake Tol Ascarnen, and we are enlisting all who are able to take the fight to the Hoardale and defeat the Uruk in charge of the Ongbúrz war-host.
'North and west of Glân Vraig lay the Hoardale and on an island in the centre of the river is Tol Ascarnen. Make your way there and defeat the tyrant and his war-host.
'Return to me when you have done this. Do not be fool-headed, this is not a mission for one or a handful. You will need a great many to best this foe.'

'You have scored a great victory for the Free Peoples, ${PLAYER}. We honour your accomplishment and duty, but also warn that we cannot relent in our battle against the Enemy.
'If we do not remain resolute, the Enemy will drive south and swallow this land in war.'
Defeat Tyrant Trintrû and reclaim Tol Ascarnen. You must not be defeated when the tyrant falls
Speak with Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent at Glân Vraig
Raid: Tyrant Trintrû
Tol Ascarnen has fallen to the Enemy. You have been tasked by Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent at Glân Vraig to find and defeat Tyrant Trintrû within the walls of Tol Ascarnen.
'You will find the tyrant in the upper reaches of Tol Ascarnen. Make your way there and defeat him. Only then can Captain-General Mákan retake Tol Ascarnen and secure this most important location.'

Tol Ascarnen, once the citadel responsible for the manufacture and storage of Rhudauran weapons and armour, lay to the north and west of Glân Vraig.
Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent directed you to kill Tyrant Trintrû at Tol Ascarnen.

Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent awaits your return at Glân Vraig.
Facing down the enemy, you destroyed the Tyrant at Tol Ascarnen. You should return to Sergeant-at-Arms Thurimbent with the news.

'Goblins! Goblins mining in the hills. And now there is a troll!
'The mine is overrun. The troll-tyrant by the name of Bûrzgoth moved to Grothum. We're asking all who are willing to go north in search of the beast. Find him, defeat him.
'You'll want to bring an army to face this foe, ${CLASS}.'

'Finally a place worth the strength of the dwarves! We shall do what we can to hold the mine, though no doubt the Ongbúrz have already ordered a counterattack. You've done well, ${PLAYER}.
'If we had more like you, the fight to keep the enemy from the south would be won quickly.'
Defeat Tyrant Bûrzgoth
Raid: Tyrant Bûrzgoth
Defeated Tyrant Bûrzgoth

Along the northern edge of the Ettenmoors, in the low-lands of the Mountains of Angmar in the lands called Arador's End there is a mine: Isendeep. Here, goblins toil and delve into the metals, plundering from the earth.
'Preserve the ore, but defeat that troll. We need to take that mine to strengthen our forces here in the Ettenmoors.'

Grothum is to the north of Glán Vraig.
Sergeant-at-Arms Hafthor asked you to make your way to Grothum to defeat the troll-tyrant Bûrzgoth.

Sergeant-at-Arms Hafthor awaits news of your victory over the Tyrant Bûrzgoth at Glân Vraig.
You met the Tyrant Bûrzgoth at Isendeep and drove him from the mine. You should return to Sergeant-at-Arms Hafthor with the news.
The Free Peoples claim the Grimwood Lumber-yard

'There's been a terrible turn in the Grimwood over in Hithlad, ${CLASS}. A troll moved in and swept clean the people that were watching over the area.
'We received orders to recruit folk willing to make the journey west into Hithlad in search of the Grimwood Lumber-yard to face down and defeat the Tyrant Gundzor. If you are willing, make your way west in search of the beast and strike him down. Then return to me when you're done.
'Don't try to be too much of a hero, ${CLASS}. You'll not face a foe like that on your own, nor with a company of friends. Take a lot more to defeat a terrible foe like Gundzor.'

'Better news has not blessed these ears in many days, my friend. You proved a mighty warrior and asset to the Free Peoples here, ${PLAYER}.
'I shall not forget what you have done!'
Defeat Tyrant Gundzor and claim the Grimwood Lumber-yard. You must not be defeated when the Tyrant falls
Raid: Tyrant Gundzor
Within the depths of the Grimwood there is a grove where the trees have been cleared and a small lumber-camp built. The grove has fallen to the Ongbúrz and must be reclaimed.

'Take the beast down quickly so we can move back into the wood and have a better spot to strike at the enemy from.
'I'm rambling too much... get out there and defeat that troll!'

The Grimwood Lumber-yard lay near the centre of Hithlad.
Sergeant-at-Arms Hafthor asked you to find and defeat the troll-tyrant Gundzor at the Grimwood Lumber-yard.

Sergeant-at-Arms Hafthor awaits news of your victory over the Tyrant Gundzor at Glân Vraig.
You met the Tyrant Gundzor within the lumber-yard and defeated him and his forces, taking the yard back for the Free Peoples. You should return to Sergeant-at-Arms Hafthor with the news.
Collected tokens of valour (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Do you see this? This is my Orc-cleaver. I was given this by Captain-General Lainedhel himself. That's right, this weapon was cooled in the rapids of the Noisewater in Rivendell. It barters for roughly one-hundred and ten beryls. It's got a sturdy oaken shaft and hardened Elf-steel blade. With me on the job, it's ready to fight at any moment.
'Now I know you are wondering how you can come by such a masterful piece of work. Well, I'll tell you: Valour. You prove your valour to the Free Peoples, and I'll see that you're fairly rewarded. No, you can't touch my blade. Your primitive mind wouldn't understand the relation of woods and alloys... things like magic.
'You want one of these types of weapons, you will need to earn it. Return to me when you've acquired enough tokens of valour, and we'll talk.'

'You got them all... excellent work! This key opens the chests behind me. I know what you're thinking: \qWhat am I supposed to do? Open one chest, what?\q
'I can solve this for you simply. The key will only open one chest. You want to open more, you need more keys. You want more keys... you go through me. You got that?
'All right. These are treasures found while we fight this war. Do yourself a favour and don't ask from where they came.'

'Valorous or not valorous, it doesn't matter. I'm the one with the keys.
'Until you prove to me that you're something more than another would-be warrior who stands about asking, \qHow will we stop this army of Angmar at our walls? How will we fight that?\q you're not getting a thing.
'Get out there and earn some tokens of valour.'
Deliver the tokens of valour to Quartermaster Ash
Collect tokens of valour (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
The Valorous

Having assisted the Free Peoples in their battle against the war-host of Angmar, you have earned much respect. The respect you earn entitles you to receive rewards from Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig.

Quartermaster Ash is at Glân Vraig in the Ettenmoors.
Ash sent you to earn tokens of valour by assisting members of the Free Peoples.

'People come and take the mine, and the Snowreap retreat to the village. You come now to take back the mine so we work and give you ore again?
'Too many dwarves. Too many dwarves poking about in the stone, digging the ore for themselves. Kill them, says I. Kill them all.
'You kill them, and we work extra hard and speak good of what you done. Kill them, aye?'

'You done? Killed them good. Good. No more dwarves means goblins can mine and then give ore to Angmar!
'Kill them all, says I. For the glory of the Great Eye!'
Dwarves in the Mine
Goblins complain that the mine is overrun by dwarves, and they are not pleased by the intrusion. They bid you to enter the Isendeep to slaughter the dwarf-miners.
'You go to the mine and kill dwarves. Come back when done.'

The Isendeep mine lay to the west of Grothum. If there are no dwarves within the mine, make your way to the western entrance and search for them there.
Gasham asked you to enter the mine and slaughter the dwarves so the goblins can return to work.

Gasham awaits news of the mines at Grothum, the goblin-village in the north-east Ettenmoors.
You entered the mine and slaughtered all the dwarves you found. You should return to Gasham with the news.

'Swoop down, they do. You'll see when they come, flying on armoured wings, swooping into the tunnels, eating up a goblin in one gulp!
'Now you here to help. Snowreap help Angmar, Angmar help the Snowreap. Into the mine, out of the mine, flying, walking, stalking, they seek us in the hills and snow. They are the ebb of winter and have fangs as tall as me!
'Kill the drakes, yes? Kill them to help the Snowreap.'

'We thanks you! We thanks you great for the help you give.
'No more gobbled up goblins. We fight, but they strong. We give them meat, but they eat us. Too strong the drakes be, but not for Angmar!
'Glory to Angmar!'
Return to Gasham at Grothum
Gobbled Goblins
Gasham conveyed a tale of goblin-miners and goblins out and about from the village attacked by drakes stalking down from the mountain. He asked for your assistance in ridding the peaks of the beasts.
'Seek them in the hills here and there to the west. They like the winter land and snow.'

Wintersebb drakes and drakelings can be found throughout Arador's End.
Gasham begged for your help against the Wintersebb drakes.

Gasham is in the goblin-village of Grothum.
You hunted the drakes in the mountainous area of Arador's End and culled their number. You should return to Gasham with the news.
Collected Chieftain's seal

'You there, ${RACE}, I have task for you.
'Chieftains command great numbers of the Enemy's forces, second only to the tyrants that lead the war-host.
'Should you run afoul of these terrors, slay them and bring me their seals so that I might see you rewarded for their defeat.'

'Each Chieftain that falls strengthens our position, ${PLAYER}. You are a hero to all the Free Peoples. Seek Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig to earn greater recognition of your efforts in the Ettenmoors.'
'Five Chieftain's seals will earn you a Token of Valour, ${PLAYER}. Keep hunting the Enemy.'
Return Chieftain's seals to First Marshal Sathryth
Collect Chieftain's seal
Angmar's Chieftains
First Marshal Sathryth at Ost Ringdyr is collecting seals found on the Chieftains of Angmar's army in the Ettenmoors.

The Chieftains of Angmar may be found among the Enemy in the Ettenmoors.
Chieftains amongst Angmar's army bear seals that denote their station. Slay them and take their seals to earn recognition amongst the Free Peoples. First Marshal Sathryth has promised a reward for the seals you bring her.
Collected tracker's badges (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Ho there, ${RACE}, lend me your ear!
'There are many servants of Angmar scattered throughout the Ettenmoors. Search amongst their army for the tracker's badges. These can be found on the lowliest of their forces.
'If you collect some of these badges and return them to me, you will be honoured with a commendation of valour.'
'Your efforts are welcomed, ${PLAYER}. Please take this with my thanks. Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig will recognize you for your efforts in the Ettenmoors should you visit him.'
'I need more of the tracker's badges before I can bestow a Token of Valour upon you, ${PLAYER}. Keep hunting the enemy down.'
Return tracker's badges to First Marshal Sathryth
Collect tracker's badges (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Angmar's Scouts
First Marshal Sathryth at Ost Ringdyr is collecting badges taken from Angmar's weakest forces.

Trackers can be found among the Enemy in the Ettenmoors.
Forces in the service to Angmar may each carry a seal of their station. Search among the enemy for these badges. First Marshal Sathryth at Ost Ringdyr has promised a reward for the badges you bring her.
Collected soldier's patches (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Have you been ignoring me, ${RACE}? I have need of your services.
'Above the rank and file, the soldiers of Angmar act as lesser leaders of the Ongbúrz forces. These beasts are savage and cruel and capable of leading only small numbers before their tempers lead to bloodshed amongst their own kind.
'Find these vile forces and bring me the patches that adorn their armour. I will reward you for ten such patches.'
'Your efforts are heralded, ${PLAYER}. Take this with my thanks. Remember that Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig will recognize you for your efforts in the Ettenmoors should you visit him.'
'I need more soldier's patches before I can bestow a Token of Valour upon you, ${PLAYER}. Keep hunting the Enemy.'
Return soldier's patches to First Marshal Sathryth
Collect soldier's patches (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Angmar's Soldiers
First Marshal Sathryth at Ost Ringdyr is collecting badges taken from Angmar's soldiers.

Soldiers in the service to Angmar may each carry a seal of their station. Search among the enemy for these badges. First Marshal Sathryth at Ost Ringdyr has promised to reward you for the patches you bring her.
Collected taskmaster's honourifics (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'You there, ${RACE}, what are you doing? I need your assistance.
'Beneath the chieftains of the Ongbúrz are the taskmasters who drive the host into a frenzy and force them to set upon our forces with sadistic glee.
'Seek them out and take their honourifics. Return some of these honourifics to me, and I will see that you are justly rewarded.'

'Your continued efforts fuel the strength that fills the arms and hearts of the Free Peoples. Thank you, ${PLAYER}. Visit Quartermaster Ash at Glân Vraig to earn greater recognition of your efforts in the Ettenmoors.'
'You need to bring me more of the taskmasters' honourifics to earn you a Token of Valour, ${PLAYER}. Keep hunting the Enemy.'
Return taskmaster's honourifics to First Marshal Sathryth
Collect taskmaster's honourifics (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
