You have created an empowered sapphire
Destroy accursed armourers (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Defeat the Cargûl Forge-master
Use the ancient anvil
Instance: The Ghost-forge
You must destroy the fell spirits that have taken up residence in this chamber, as well as their master, if you are to reach the forge and complete the quality you seek.
You must destroy the accursed armoursmiths, as well their wraith master, to dispel the evil they have woven about this ancient forge.
Use the ancient forge to empower your infused sapphire.
The Ghost-forge remains haunted!

'There is a forge I know of which may be used to craft the beginnings of the qualities you seek to bestow upon your weapon. Something evil and accursed has crept into the ancient forge, however, and I deem it too dangerous now to go there.
'However, you should not even consider looking for it if you haven't an infused sapphire. Such a stone is necessary to capture the power needed to imbue your weapon. If you can manage to find an infused sapphire, I will tell you the way to the forge....'

'Ah! So you have found an infused sapphire. This stone will do nicely, but once I have prepared it, you will need to take it to the ancient forge to complete the process.
'Let me know when you are ready, and I will tell you the way....'
'You will need to bring me an infused sapphire before we can begin.'

'Well fought, ${PLAYER}! I know not what the wraith-slaves of Mordor have in mind claiming our forebears' forges for their evil crafts, but it is well that their task has failed.
'Now hand that empowered sapphire here and I'll see what needs to be done yet to bestow the qualities you seek.'
'Were you not able to empower the stone? Without an empowered sapphire, I cannot help you.'
Bring an infused sapphire to Fastarr
Talk to Fastarr to travel to the Ghost-forge
Bring the empowered sapphire to Fastarr
The Ghost-forge
Fastarr knows of a forge where you may craft the heart of the qualities you seek, but the dwarves believe that it may be haunted by evil spectres of some sort.

'Take care, ${PLAYER}. I know not what lies within the forges of our forefathers, but any who have dared approach the doors have spoken of a sense of unsettling dread from within. If you are ready, then steel your heart against evil and set forth.'
<rgb=#FF0000>This is a Solo quest, and cannot be completed with a Fellowship.</rgb>
'My thanks to you for clearing out that accursed forge. I wonder what it is the wraiths of Mordor hoped to craft in those halls?'
Fastarr has asked you to bring him an infused sapphire with which the qualities you desire may be bestowed upon your weapon.

Fastarr can be found at the Dolven-view camp in Moria.
Fastarr has bidden you to speak with him when you are ready to seek out the forge, but warns you that some unnatural force appears to have taken control of it.

Fastarr can be found at the Dolven-view camp in Moria.
You should return to Fastarr to complete the enhancement of your weapon.
You have found Ânghumu-ru -- hopefully Feggi's outpost is near!

'Please make for Ânghumu-ru at once and warn Feggi and his dwarves about the danger. Hopefully it is not too late.
'Ânghumu-ru is south-west of Anazârmekhem. Be careful out there! The roads are dangerous.'

'Thank goodness! I was afraid we would meet our ends here, caught like rats in a trap.
'You were sent to warn us of the reinforcements, were you? Alas! We found that out on our own. Nonetheless, I am thankful you arrived when you did. It might not be too late to warn Gúthi!'
Head towards Ânghumu-ru

The dwarves who made their way to the Orc-watch from the Twenty-first Hall appear to have set discouraging traps for their enemies, but the traps are no longer working.

Allies of Mordor
The dwarves who made their way to the Orc-watch from the Twenty-first Hall appear to have set discouraging traps for their enemies, but the traps are no longer working.

The traps are in the southern halls of Zelem-melek, to the west and north of the Orc-watch. The dwarves placed them near Gabil-mamach and Budkhul-tharâkh.
You should arm the traps that have stopped working to help make the passages safer against the enemies of Khazad-dûm.

Collected spears from White Hand Orcs in Skrithûrz-ulíma (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

Moria is full of ancient caches of the weapons of the forebears of the dwarves. Most of the finer pieces are long since gone, but the Orcs of Skrithûrz-ulíma have found a trove of spears.
Spears are dangerous weapons in the hands of a skilled opponent.

You can tell the marks of a true craftsman when his work holds up for an age.
You have salvaged valuable weapons from the wrong hands, and have likely saved the lives of many innocent dwarves who would have felt the ends of those spears used upon them.
Collect spears from Orcs at Skrithûrz-ulíma
Collect spears from White Hand Orcs in Skrithûrz-ulíma (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Instruments of the Enemy
The Orcs of Moria have long plundered the caches of ancient dwarf-weapons stored within the ancient halls, but the spears that they now use are particularly vicious and deadly.

Spear-wielding Orcs can be found at Skrithûrz-ulíma to the north-west of the Orc-watch.
The Orcs are wielding spears stolen from the ancient weapon-vaults of Moria.

Spear-wielding Orcs can be found at Skrithûrz-ulíma to the north-west of the Orc-watch.
The Orcs are wielding spears stolen from the ancient weapon-vaults of Moria.
You have salvaged many ancient spears from the Orcs of Skrithûrz-ulíma.

'Do you have time enough to aid the expedition again? I would like you to speak with a friend of mine, Águti. He has travelled deeper into Moria with the expedition, and I have yet to hear back from him.
'You can find Águti down in the old Water-works in a place we call the Rotting Cellar, south-west of here, past the Silvertine Lodes.
'I'm given to understand that it isn't considered the most comfortable post....'

'Well met, ${PLAYER}. So, Simbi sent you down here did he? He must not like you very much then....
'No! No! 'Twas but a jest! It's just a bit damp down here but you get used to it -- as long as you can keep the mould out of your beard.
'I've been studying the creatures of Moria since I arrived here -- as much as I can without being devoured by them, at any rate -- and have learned a few things. If you would be willing to aid me, I'm sure we can uncover their secrets!'
Talk to Águti at the Rotting Cellar camp
Águti's Advice
Simbi is interested to hear from one of his friends, Aguti, about the progress of the expedition in the Water-works.
'Go see Águti in the Rotting Cellar.'

Águti is at the Rotting Cellar camp in the Water-works, far south-west of the Twenty-first Hall.
Simbi has asked you to speak with Águti regarding the progress of the expedition in the Water-works.
Collected a grodbog scent-gland (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'I should like to learn about these odious insects while you're working on driving them off. Will you do me a great favour, and bring me anything out of the ordinary that can be found on their anatomy?
'I hope that studying the gredbyg will give us better tools to fight them.'

'Scent-glands, eh? Very interesting...I have not seen many creatures such as this in possession of glands of this nature.
'I have a theory, ${PLAYER}. Perhaps these can be used to lure whatever menace is at the centre of the infestation at the Palace of Náin, eh?'
Collect grodbog scent-glands (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Bring the scent-glands to Thórhall
Scent of the Hive
Thórhall hopes to study the anatomy of gredbyg to learn more about them, so that they can be better combatted in the future.
'Have you found anything of interest on those gredbyg yet?'

Gredbyg can be found in a hive in the Palace of Náin.
You have been asked to collect anatomical items of interest from the gredbyg for study.

Thórhall is at the small dwarf-camp in Lamab-dûm in the Great Delving.
You should bring the scent-glands you have collected to Thórhall, so that he may study them.
Defeated a grodbog (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Strange sounds and strange creeping shadows surround us here... do you feel uneasy? I think it is coming from the north. There is a sickly light about that place.
'I have noticed a great increase in the gredbyg about this place. Perhaps it is their hive up yonder... will you go and thin their numbers? I will rest easier if I know there are less of them to crawl over me in my sleep!'
'Ah! A fine effort, ${PLAYER}. Would that this were the end of them! But I suppose I will have to settle for this valiant endeavour of yours. You have my thanks!'
Defeat gredbyg in the Palace of Náin (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Return to Thórhall at Lamab-dûm
The Noise of the Gredbyg
Thórhall is disturbed by the strange noises being emitted all around Lamab-dûm, and fears that the noise comes from the gredbyg that crawl all over.
'Brrr! Those gredbyg do make me shiver!'

A swarm of gredbyg can likely be found in a hive in the Palance of Náin, north of Lamab-dûm in the Great Delving.
Thórhall wants you to kill off as many gredbyg as you can.

Thórhall is at his camp in Lamab-dûm in the Great Delving.
You should return to Thórhall and tell him that the grodbog presence is somewhat lessened in the hive to the north.

Use the ancient anvil
Instance: The Training Hall

A disciplined war-band of Moria Orcs has taken up residence in one of the old armoury halls and is using it as a training hall in preparation for their next offensive against the dwarves. If you are to reach the old weapons forge within that hall and empower the infused garnet you carry, you shall have to win your way past the Orcs.
You must defeat the Orkish recruits before they are prepared to launch their offensive against the dwarves and defeat the Uruk who is overseeing their training.
Use the ancient forge to empower your infused garnet.
The armoury remains in Orc hands!

'A well-organized band of Orcs has recently overrun the hall containing the anvil you seek. If you are to reach the anvil, you will have a difficult fight on your hands.
'I can tell you how to reach the hall, but such a journey would be useless until you bring me an infused garnet. Without such a stone, you will not be able to bestow the quality you seek to place upon your weapon.
When you find such a stone, I will prepare it for you and tell you how to reach the ancient hall.'

'Ah! You have found an infused garnet at last! Now, you will need to bring that to the old armoury, but first I must prepare it.
'When you are ready to depart for the armoury, speak with me again.'
'You will need to bring me an infused garnet before we can begin.'

'So you have returned? Ah, and I see you have brought an empowered garnet. Then you were successful.
'Let us see if that stone will suffice for the quality you desire.'
'Were you not able to empower the stone? Without such a stone, I cannot help you.'
Bring an infused garnet to Fastarr
Talk to Fastarr to travel to the old armoury
Bring the empowered garnet to Fastarr
The Training Hall

Fastarr knows of an ancient anvil where you may craft the heart of the quality you seek for your weapon, but scouts report that the ancient armoury in which it lies has recently been overrun by a well-organized force of Moria Orcs, who are even now training in preparation for their next assault to drive the dwarves from Moria.

'If my scouts are correct, it seems that a particularly brutal Uruk has brought his forces up from the deeper mines and overrun the hall containing the anvil you seek. It will be no simple task to rout them from their work, but the sooner the better, for they are preparing an assault against us as we speak.
'Are you ready to face the Orcs? If so, then you should be off...time is wasting!'
<rgb=#FF0000>This is a Solo quest, and cannot be completed with a Fellowship.</rgb>

'That was good work clearing out the old armoury. There are not many brave enough to throw themselves into the teeth of an entire band of Orcs, and fewer still strong enough to see it through to the end!'
Fastarr has asked you to bring him an infused garnet with which he may be able to aid you in bestowing a quality upon your weapon. He does not, however, know where to find such a stone.

Fastarr can be found at the Dolven-view camp in Moria.
Fastarr has bidden you to speak with him again when you are ready to seek out the old armoury, but warns you that a well-organized band of Moria Orcs has taken control of the hall.

Fastarr can be found at the Dolven-view camp in Moria.
You should return to Fastarr to complete the enhancement of your weapon.

You have defeated the hive-queen!

'What do you know, ${PLAYER}; I have had an idea! If you crush the scent-glands you gathered, an overwhelming scent will be released, and the gredbyg will rise up.
'The scent will undoubtedly draw the hive-queen from her hidden nest. If you can slay her, the entire hive will be greatly weakened... at least until they can raise a new queen. That should keep them out of our way for quite a while, and that is the best we can hope for.'
'Excellent work, ${PLAYER}! With the grodbog hive-queen slain, the hive will be thrown into disarray, and their numbers will likewise diminish... at least until they can raise a new queen.'
Summon and defeat the grodbog hive-queen

Thórhall believes that the scent-glands you gathered may lure the hive-queen into revealing herself, allowing her to be slain.

'Did my plan work, ${PLAYER}?
'What? You haven't tried it yet? Well, get to it! Better you than me.'

The grodbog-lair is in the Palace of Náin, north of Lamâb-dûm.
Thórhall asked you to take the scent-glands to the grodbog-hive and crush them. The resulting scent should draw forth the hive-queen.

Thórhall is at the small dwarf-camp in Lamab-dûm, south of the Palace of Náin.
You should report back to Thórhall with news of your success.

Instance: The Mithril-slaves

You were told of a long played-out mithril-mine within which an ancient smelting-forge lies. Within it, you should be able to lay the basis for the quality you seek. However, a vicious band of Orcs has enslaved their own goblin brethren to eke out the remining tailings from the mine, making it difficult to reach the forge.

You must find enough fragments of mithril ore to make proper use of the smelting-forge for the quality. Hopefully, the goblin-slaves have managed to collect enough of the ore for your needs...though they are unlikely to part with it willingly.
Use the ancient forge and the mitrhil ore-fragments you have collected to empower your infused garnet.
You have failed to drive the Orcs from the mines!

'If you are seeking to enhance the abilities of your weapon, there is one place where you are sure to lay the foundation for such a quality. There is an old mithril mine, played-out long ago, but within it was a fine forge with mighty spells laid upon it for the smelting of mithril ore!
'Of course, now the Orcs have it and have set their own goblin brethren to work as slaves trying to eke out a few last sorry bits of the poorest quality ore. I doubt they know anything about the forge itself -- or care in the least -- but you will have to fight your way through them if you want to make use of it.
'Before you dare the mine, however, you should bring me an infused garnet. Only with such a stone will you succeed in enhancing your weapon. I do not know where to find such stone, however.'

'Ah! You were able to get your hands upon an infused garnet.
'It will take me some time to prepare the stone. When you are ready to leave for the mine, let me know, and I will return the stone to you.'
'You will need to bring me an infused garnet before we can begin.'

'Ho there! I see you are still in one piece. Excellent, and what's more, you have empowered the garnet! Well done, indeed.
'Let's have that stone, and we will see if we cannot bestow the quality you seek!'
'Were you not able to empower the stone? Without an empowered garnet, I cannot help you.'
Bring an infused garnet to Mundgeirr
Talk to Mundgeirr to travel to the mithril mine
Bring the empowered garnet to Mundgeirr
The Mithril Slaves

Mundgeirr knows of an ancient mithril mine containing a smelting forge where you may lay the foundation of the quality you seek to bestow upon your weapon. Unfortunately, a band of particularly savage Orcs has claimed the mine and enslaved their own goblin brethren to work the played-out veins in hope of coming up with a few poor scraps of mithril ore for their masters.

'If you are ready to go, I'm sure the Orcs are as ready as they are likely to be. If you are lucky they will be too busy digging and yelling at each other to notice you wandering through...but it will take quite a lot of luck, I'm afraid.
'Now don't forget, you may need a small bit of that mithril ore yourself if you are going to infuse that garnet properly, so you may need to borrow a bit from the Orcs along the way, if there is any to be had.'
<rgb=#FF0000>This is a Solo quest, and cannot be completed with a Fellowship.</rgb>
'Ah! That was fine work in the mine. I trust the quality is all you were hoping for?'
Mundgeirr has asked you to bring him an infused garnet with which he may aid you in bestowing a quality upon your weapon. He does not know, however, where to find such a stone.

Mundgeirr can be found at the Dolven-view camp in Moria.
Mungeirr has bidden you to talk to him again when you are ready to seek out the forge, but warns you that a vicious band of Orcs and their goblin slaves have taken over the mithril mine.

Mundgeirr can be found at the Dolven-view camp in Moria.
You should return to Mundgeirr to complete the enhancement of your weapon.
Placed stone upon an altar (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'While we await information, we can still cause dissent and confusion within the ranks of the Orcs. If they came from Mordor as early emissaries into Khazad-dûm, it may be that they can be frightened into service once again.
'I have prepared several stones, each marked with the symbol of the Great Eye. Place them upon the altars found near The Cross-roads of Ash; when they see the symbol of the Eye burning upon their altars, they should rethink their allegiance.
'The altars are located on the bridge-like structures surrounding The Cross-roads of Ash.'

'The marks have been placed, and already I sense that allegiances are being questioned.
'While this is a big step towards victory, we still have much to do.'
Place stones upon the altars (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Gúthi at the Cross-roads of Ash
Dissent in the Ranks
The dwarves believe they can trick the Ghâsh-hai into allying with the forces of Mordor by convincing them that Sauron is aware of their betrayal.
'All of the altars must bear the marks for them to believe that the Dark Lord has turned his Eye upon them.'

'Greetings, traveller. What brings you to Tharâkh Bazân?

'If you wish to obtain your quality, you will have to free the forge; however, before you even attempt it, you will need to bring me an infused adamant, which can hold the quality.'

'There is but one forge remaining in Eregion where the quality you wish to obtain may be acquired. After the early years of the Third Age, the old smithy fell to ruin, and in this day the Dunlendings have built a large fortified camp upon them. Thankfully, they remain unaware of the significance of the ruins, but their presence complicates matters.
'I think it is time we did something about that camp, and though we have not the forces for a direct assault upon it, I have a more cunning, though un-subtle plan in mind.
'You must gather a small group of companions and prepare a midnight raid upon the camp! If you are successful, then making use of the forge should be within your grasp.'

'Ah! You were able to acquire an infused adamant. Now you will need to bring it to the Dunlending-camp.
'Let me know when you and your companions are ready to depart, and I will impart to you the plan I have devised.'
'You will need to bring me an infused adamant before we can begin.'

'Ah, I rather wish I could have been there to see it. As much as fire is a clumsy weapon, it does make for a merrily lit evening by sword and bow, does it not?
'With the Dunlendings routed and their camp in ruins, we should have little to worry about from that quarter for a time.
'Now, let us see about imbuing the qualities you seek, shall we?'
'Were you not able to imbue the stone? Without it I cannot help you.'

'If you and your companions are prepared, then you can set off. I have prepared a small boat for you to take up river to the eastern side of the camp, where my scouts say the defenders are the least watchful. Once you land you must quickly dispose of as many of the veteran guardsmen as possible, as they pose the greatest threat of spoiling the plan by raising an alarm.
'Once the threat of the guardsmen is removed, make your way to the centre of the camp where you will find a great bonfire that the Dunlendings keep well lit day and night. Once you reach it, you should put someone to the task of setting fire to as many of the tents surrounding it as possible, sowing chaos throughout the camp.
'If you can set enough of the camp alight, the remaining soldiers should quit the camp in fear, leaving you the space you need to do your work at the forge.'
'So you and your companions managed to burn the Dunlendings out of their camp? Well done! That is one less obstacle to overcome ere this War is over!'

'Alas, Pembar is of little enough value for us to risk trying to retake it now. If you need to reach that forge, I suggest you gather a few companions and see if you can dislodge the Drakes by your own cunning and skill.
'In any case, you will need an infused garnet if you wish to obtain the quality you seek there. Return to me when you have one and bring a couple of stalwart companions to aid you.'

The half-orcs at Târ Stazg were dismayed by the defeat of Akashpug, but were not driven off.
'The half-orc tents are spread throughout Târ Stazg to the north-east.'
'Hail, ${PLAYER}, Bane of the half-orcs!'

The half-orc tents are at Târ Stazg, north-east of Echad Dúnann, along the mountains before the Redhorn Gate.
In order to drive the disorganized half-orcs from Eregion, Palanaer has tasked you with destroying their tents.

Palanaer is in Echad Dúnann, south-west of Târ Stazg.
You should return to Palanaer and report your success.

'Your efforts have been valiant, ${PLAYER}, but I fear they will come to naught. The half-orcs have brethren encamped in the Redhorn Gate, and Dunlendings in the service of Saruman are encamped not far to the east.
'I ask that you go to Echad Dúnann to the east, near the gates of Moria called the Doors of Durin, and speak with Glavroleth. Warn her of the threat of the half-orcs...perhaps she will have some insight into their presence.
'Go forth without delay, ${PLAYER}. I fear an evil tide is rising.'

'Welcome, ${PLAYER}. You come with tidings from Lengliel?
'The half-orcs have entered the ruins of Eregion? This is old news to us, but Lengliel is right to be concerned. There is some evil at work here, against which we must prepare ourselves.'
Talk to Glavroleth at Echad Dúnann
Aid from the East
Lengliel fears that the half-orcs at Barad Morlas and Pembar may call reinforcements from the east.
'Go to Echad Dúnann, ${PLAYER}, and warn Glavroleth of the half-orc threat.'

Echad Dúnann lies along the road south and east from Echad Eregion, in Nan Sirannon.
Lengliel has asked you to seek out Glavroleth at Echad Dúnann.

'Though the half-orcs are no longer a threat to Echad Dúnann, I fear that they may attempt an assault upon Echad Mirobel.
'Mirobel has long lain in ruin and is already nearly overrun; if even a part of the half-orc host of Târ Stazg joined in the assault, the Elves at Echad Mirobel may be overrun.
'Echad Mirobel lies west of Echad Dúnann, along the Nan Sirannon road. Go and warn Gelirwen. Render any aid that you may in their defence.'

'An assault from Târ Stazg? This is grim news indeed, ${CLASS}.
'Preparations must begin at once against such an assault.'
Talk to Gelirwen at Echad Mirobel
Armies of the South
Palanaer fears that half-orcs are not the only threat to Echad Mirobel.
'Echad Mirobel is west of Echad Dúnann along the Nan Sirannon road.'
'Echad Mirobel must not fall to the Half-orcs.'

Echad Mirobel is west of Echad Dúnann along the Nan Sirannon road.
You have been asked to warn Echad Mirobel of the half-orc threat.
Defeated crebain (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Well met, friend.
'No doubt you have heard of the White Hand's many spies in this land. A favourite spy of Saruman are the crebain.
'Our scouts report a large number of crebain along the northern edges of the valley far to the east of Gwingris. Find them and rid our valley of their menace before they discover something that should remain hidden.'

'Well done, ${PLAYER}. That should limit the White Hand's ability to gather knowledge of our forces here...and of other things that should remain hidden.
'With their numbers weakened by your efforts, we have an opportunity to strike a decisive blow against their tenuous foothold here in Eregion.'
Defeat crebain (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Thaliondir in Gwingris
An Army of Eyes
A large flock of crebain out of Dunland has descended upon Eregion, spying for signs of the passing of the Company from Rivendell.
'Crebain have been spotted to the east. Our scouts report a large number of the birds along the northern edge of the valley.'

The crebain may be found in the valley far to the east of Gwingris.
Thaliondir has asked you to go forth and defeat Saruman's craban-spies.

Thaliondir is at Gwingris, far to the west of the craban-nests.
You should return to Thaliondir with news of your success.
Defeated Tudur

'Our scouts have reported that the few remaining Dunlendings have managed to reinforce their lumber-camp. Apparently, they have a battle-horn with which they can summon their leader, a man by the name of Tudur.
'Return to the Dunlending-camp, ${PLAYER}, and look to the east of the pond. Search for their battle-horn and use it to challenge Tudur. When he arrives, defeat him...perhaps then the Dunlendings will return to their own land.
'Hurry, ${PLAYER}, before Saruman can send allies to reinforce the camp.'

'Well done again, ${PLAYER}. With their leader gone, I do not doubt that the Dunlendings will soon return to their homes in the south.
'You have earned the gratitude of both Elf and tree this day, ${PLAYER}. Thank you.'
Use the battle-horn to summon Tudur and defeat him
Talk to Inufileg at Gwingris
The Captain of Sâd Rechu
Dunlendings have established a lumber-camp in the wooded land of Sâd Rechu, where they collect wood for the use of Saruman's craftsmen.
'My scouts tell me that the Dunlendings' battle-horn lies just beyond the pond to the east of Gwingris, in Sâd Rechu. Start your search there.'
'The Dunlendings should no longer be a true threat to us, thanks to your efforts.'

The battle-horn is in the camp east of the pond at Sâd Rechu, east of Gwingris.
Inufileg has instructed you to use the Dunlendings' battle-horn to issue a challenge to their leader, Tudur.

Inufileg is at Gwingris, west of Sâd Rechu.
You should return to Gwingris and tell Inufileg of your success.
Found the body of Thorlák

'If the goat was killed recently, there is still a chance that Thorlák made camp, but is unable to return. Caradhras the Cruel can entangle even the hardiest explorers if they are not prepared.
'Return to the Redhorn Gate and search its northern reaches. Thorlák's supplies would almost certainly be spent by now if he was forced to seek shelter on the hard face of Zirakzigil.
'I can only hope that Thorlák is having a merry time, sitting among the ancient treasures next to a warm fire in Durin's Tower....'
The body of the dwarf is frozen, its last moments of life preserved by the cold. It would appear that Thorlák met his end in the peaceful embrace of slumber.

'Thorlák is dead? This is grievous news ${PLAYER}, for he was a close friend, as true of heart as any dwarf could ask, and as tough as stone.
'Alas that he died for a fool's hope, for Durin's Tower is lost to us forever.'
Find Thorlák
Talk to Hjór at Echad Dúnann
Caradhras the Cruel
You discovered the corpse of a slain Redhorn-goat, which Hjór took as a good sign that his friend may yet live, for the corpse was expertly skinned.
'Search for Thorlák among the highest reaches of the Redhorn Gate.'
'Caradhras the Cruel can entangle even the hardiest explorers if they are not prepared.'

Thorlák entered the Redhorn Gate in search of Durin's Tower in the eastern parts of the pass, upon Zirakzigil.
Hjór hopes that Thorlák has found some shelter in the upper reaches of the Redhorn Gate.

Hjór is in Echad Dúnann, south-west of the Redhorn Gate.
You should return to Hjór and inform him of Thorlák's death.
Retrieved a cooking pot
Found the thief

'Your return here is all that may stand in the way of success. But not all is yet lost.
'The remaining half-orc will likely ride hard for Isengard, but that will hinder him more than aid him... he will be forced to stop the sooner to rest his mount. That is when you will need to strike.
'From what you tell me, I would guess he would make for the Dunlending camp of Porth Cadlus, south of the Sirannon. The encampment lies to the south-east of here, but I would look first along the northern banks of the Sirannon, now dry... that is where he would most likely rest his horse.'
'This was all you found upon the half-orc? We are fortunate that it was something so common and unremarkable!'
'Were you unable to find the remaining half-orc? Try along the northern banks of the Sirannon, south-east of here.'
Retrieve what was taken from the Company's camp-site
Quickly find the thief
Bring the pot to Golgallon
Chasing Trouble
You caught up with one of the half-orcs who ransacked the Company's camp-site, but the other had already continued southwards with their stolen prize.
'The last half-orc must be stopped from fulfilling his mission, ${PLAYER}!'

The remaining half-orc might be found along the northern banks of the dry Sirannon river-bed, south-east of Echad Eregion.
Golgallon suggests that there is a chance to stop the remaining half-orc when he stops to rest his horse.

Golgallon is at Echad Eregion, north-west of the Sirannon.
You should bring the pot you found back to Golgallon.
Defeated Horngoth

'Do you see this sign here? Perhaps your eye is not trained to see it. This banner names one Horngoth, a half-orc of a most ill repute, as the leader of these forces.
'Journey now to Barad Morlas. At the northern foot of a bridge which leads further into the ruins, you will find a summoning horn, not unlike the one at Pembar. Blow upon the horn, and surely Horngoth will answer.
'The bridge lies south-west of here. Hurry!'

'It is good that you have defeated Horngoth, but his defeat may just bring more enemies down upon us. Our scouts tell us that there are more servants of the White Hand in the passes of the Redhorn Gate and Nan Sirannon.'
Blow the summoning horn at Barad Morlas and defeat Horngoth
Talk to Lengliel at Echad Eregion
Chief of the Invaders
Lengliel had you collect several White Hand banners and bring them to her. From them, she has been able to learn the identity of the half-orcs' leader.
'Find the summoning horn at Barad Morlas, south-west of here, and use it to challenge Horngoth!'
'The half-orcs at Barad Morlas suffer now, but I believe they may call for reinforcements....'

The summoning horn is at the northern foot of a bridge in Barad Morlas, south-west of Echad Eregion.
Lengliel has asked you to use the summoning horn of Barad Morlas to challenge Horngoth, the leader of the half-orcs there.

Lengliel is at Echad Eregion, north-east of Barad Morlas.
You should return to Lengliel and tell her of your victory at Barad Morlas.
Defeated crebain (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'No doubt your gaze has been drawn to the peaks of Celebdil, Caradhras, and Fanuidhol, but there a great shadow often defeats my eyes. Great, dark clouds move against the wind, and they pass over the land in search of something.
'Flocks of black-winged crebain from Dunland have been circling the Redhorn Gate. It is clear that they are searching for the Company, and I fear that they may have news or have found some clue that we have not ourselves discovered.
'Travel north-east into the Redhorn Gate and defeat these spies of Saruman, then return to me.'

'Just before your return a great concourse of birds flew hastily from the Redhorn Gate. Let us hope that you set enough fear into their ranks to drive them from Eregion, though I doubt not that they will return to pick the bones of the fallen.'
Defeat crebain (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Authlanc at Echad Dúnann
The Crebain of Caradhras
Crebain out of Dunland in the service of Saruman spy out the crevices of the Redhorn Gate, threatening the efforts of the Elves in Eregion.
'The crebain can be found in the Redhorn Gate north-east of Echad Dúnann.'
'Let us hope that you drove the foul crebain from Eregion.'

Crebain can be found north-east of Echad Dúnann in the Redhorn Gate.
Authlanc has asked that you defeat crebain in the Redhorn Gate.

Authlanc can be found at Echad Dúnann south-east of the Redhorn Gate.
You should return to Authlanc and tell him of your success.

'So, ${PLAYER}, we now know whither the Company has gone. They have surely passed into the long dark of Moria. May the Valar guide their steps, for it is said Durin's Bane dwells there still... though none can say for certain, as no one in this age has ever laid eyes upon it.
'Here, then, is the last task appointed to us: we must confuse their trail, so that the Enemy cannot be prepared for their passage. Speak again with Ruidhriel and Limlaer... they will know what to do.
'If you have forgotten, Ruidhriel is encamped near the Burnt Tor to the north-west, while you may find Limlaer along the road to the south-west.'

'It is done, then. The safety of the Company is out of our hands. We must now turn our attention to our own roles in the coming War.
'You have the gratitude of the Free Peoples, ${PLAYER}.'
Help Ruidhriel
Help Limlaer
Talk to Rinneldor at Echad Dúnann
A Dark, Secret Way

While the Company did try the Redhorn Gate, they were forced to turn back. Neither was there any sign of their passing towards the Gap of Rohan, leaving but one direction open to Rinneldor's mind: Moria.
'We must throw the Enemy off the trail of the Company. Speak with Ruidhriel and Limlaer and learn what they would have you do.'

Ruidhriel is encamped near the Burnt Tor, north-west of Echad Dúnann. Limlaer may be found along the road, south-west of Echad Dúnann.
Rinneldor has asked you to once again speak with Ruidhriel and Limlaer to learn what must be done to confuse the Company's trail.

Rinneldor is at Echad Dúnann, south-east of the Burnt Tor and north-east of Limlaer's post.
You should return to Rinneldor with news of your successes.
Defeated half-orcs in Târ Stazg (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'The half-orcs at Târ Stazg prepare for battle; one of the messengers out of Barad Morlas must have reached them sometime in the night.
'We cannot allow them to bring a force to bear at Barad Morlas. Assail their camp and reduce their numbers; it will be with a small host that they will issue forth to strengthen the battle.
'Târ Stazg lies north-east of Echad Dúnann along the mountains before the Redhorn Gate. Go as quickly as you can and return once their numbers have been reduced.'
'You have done a brave deed thinning the ranks of the half-orcs, ${PLAYER}. Perhaps now they will not be so quick to render aid to Barad Morlas.'
Defeat half-orcs in Târ Stazg (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Palanaer at Echad Dúnann
Delaying Aid
A messenger from Barad Morlas has reached the half-orcs at Târ Stazg, warning them of the presence of the Elves in Eregion.
'Târ Stazg is north-east of Echad Dúnann along the mountains before the Redhorn Gate. You must hurry before they bring aid to Barad Morlas!'
'You have done a brave deed thinning the ranks of the half-orcs.'

Târ Stazg is north-east of Echad Dúnann along the mountains before the Redhorn Gate.
Palanaer has asked you to journey to Târ Stazg and defeat the Half-orcs before they can reinforce Barad Morlas.

Palanaer is in Echad Dúnann south-west of Târ Stazg.
You should return to Palanaer and tell him of the half-orc defeat.
Collected axes from the Dunlendings (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'You were right to bring this to my attention, ${PLAYER}. Not only are there brigands at our very doorstep, nor are they simply taking our forest, they are part of a larger plan at work that we do not yet understand. Undoubtedly they are providing wood for the craftsmen of Saruman, but to what goal, I do not know.
'It is not for me to surmise the greater purpose behind these matters. For now let us deal with the problem at hand. Go back to the Dunlendings' lumber-camp, south-east of Gwingris, and take their axes from them.
'Return to me when you have finished. Without the proper tools, their butchery of the wood will end.'
'Good work, ${PLAYER}. This should slow down their efforts, while we delve deeper into their intentions.'
'Have you collected the Dunlendings' axes yet, ${PLAYER}?'
Talk to Inufileg at Gwingris
Collect axes from the Dunlendings (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Destroying their Means
The Dunlendings are ravaging Glâd Ereg, cutting down trees to supply the craftsmen of Saruman with wood.
'Without their axes, the Dunlendings will be unable to further harm this forest. Thank you, ${PLAYER}.'

The Dunlending lumber-camp is south-east of Gwingris. Inufileg is at Gwingris, west and north of the Dunlending lumber-camp
Inufileg has asked you to stop the Dunlendings' wood-cutting by taking their axes from them.

'It seems that the White Hand is coming against us from all sides here in Eregion, ${PLAYER}. The note you brought me clearly mentions 'Pembar.' Pembar is near our way-post at Echad Eregion. If the half-orcs are at work in that area, then our kindred need to know.
'To find Echad Eregion, head south out of Gwingris. Look to the south-east as you follow the road... Echad Eregion will be found amid some small ruins.
'Deliver this message to Lengliel. She will know what to do.'

'Well met and welcome to Echad Eregion. What news do you bring from Gwingris?
'Half-orcs stealing worm-eggs? Yes, I know somewhat of this. Let us speak further on the matter....'
Talk to Lengliel at Echad Eregion
Disturbing News
Calelloth believes news of the half-orcs' dealings with the worms of Eregion should be conveyed throughout the Elf-camps.
'Echad Eregion is south-east of Gwingris. Follow the road out of Gwingris, and you should find it soon enough.'

Lengliel is at Echad Eregion, south-east of Gwingris.
Calelloth has asked you to deliver a letter to Lengliel regarding the half-orcs and worms.
Defeated Râkhuga the Tracker
You set the false camp-site

'It seems that your trail worked, ${PLAYER}. A tracking-party was seen by another of my scouts close at hand to the false trail. Now we must draw the trap closed!
'Travel south-west of here between Porth Cadlus and Goeolhad. Look to the south of the ravine that runs westward to the hilltop above for some tall boulders overlooking a small clearing that lies just west of the tower on the edge of Nan Sirannon.
'There, you must set up a false camp and lie in wait for the scouts. Be careful, though... the scouts must not be allowed to return to their foul masters.
'If the Enemy is tricked into believing that the Company has gone through the Gap of Rohan or around the White Mountains, their real trail may remain hidden for good. Return to me when you have completed the task.'
'The scout-leader lies dead? You have done a great thing, ${PLAYER}. I will report of your deeds to Lord Elrond.'
'Have you dealt with the scout-leader?'
Set the false camp-site and defeat Râkhuga
Talk to Limlaer
Drawing the Enemy
Limlaer has enlisted your aid in setting false trails to lure the Enemy south.
'You should set the camp south-west of here, between Porth Cadlus and Goeolhad, in a boulder-encircled basin, but you must hurry before the scouts find the real trail.'
'You did well in dealing with the scout-leader, ${PLAYER}.'

The site for the false camp is south-west of Limlaer, between Porth Cadlus and Goeolhad, in a boulder-encircled basin.
Limlaer has tasked you with setting a trap for the scouts of the Enemy.

Limlaer is south-east of Echad Dúnann, along the Nan Sirannon road.
You should return to Limlaer with news of your success.
Defeated half-orcs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Our scouts report that a group of half-orcs have been stealing worm-eggs. This is troubling news, ${PLAYER}. I can only imagine their ultimate purpose with the worm-eggs.
'For now, though, let us deal with the immediate threat. The very presence of half-orcs in the area speaks of these evil times.
'Journey to Pend Eregion in the south-east and hunt down the servants of the White Hand. These half-orc abominations must be put to an end.'

'You have done well, ${PLAYER}. For now, the half-orcs have been thwarted.
'Rest for a while, for you will need your strength again before long.'
Defeat half-orcs (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Calelloth at Gwingris
Saruman's half-orcs have been seen stealing worm-eggs. Thus far, their full purpose remains unclear.
'Our scouts reported seeing a small group of half-orcs in Pend Eregion to the south-east some distance away, just south of the road to Rivendell.'

Half-orcs can be found south-east of Gwingris.
Calelloth has instructed you to go forth and defeat the half-orcs who are stealing worm-eggs for their master.

Calelloth is at Gwingris, north-west of where you found the half-orcs.
You should speak with Calelloth regarding your victory against the half-orcs.
You have set the false trail

'${PLAYER}, I am glad that you have returned. We still have much to accomplish.
'The servants of the Enemy are closer at hand than even Master Elrond has feared. If we do not act quickly, they may discover the path of the Company...to the ruin of us all.
'We must devise a false trail to mislead the Enemy into believing that the Company has passed south, nearer to the Gap of Rohan. Travel south-west of here and west of Porth Cadlus, and disturb the ground there. Perhaps we can trick the foul scouts and secure more time for the Company to put this place well behind them.'
'The trail has been placed? Then we must continue to aid the Company as best we may.'
Set a false trail
Talk to Limlaer
A False Trail
The spies of the Enemy seek continually for the trail of the Company, threatening their safety and their quest.
'The best place to set the trail is south-west of here and west of Porth Cadlus.'
'The scouts of the enemy must not find the trail.'

The place you should set a false trail lies to the south-west of Limlaer and west of Porth Cadlus.
Limlaer has asked you to set false trails for the scouts of the Enemy to find.

Limlaer is south-west of Echad Dúnann, along the Nan Sirannon road.
You should return to Limlaer and inform him that the false trail has been set.
The camp-site has been ransacked

'Our own scouts discovered another camp-site to the east and somewhat north of here, just beyond Torech Bornagol and Torech Carangor. We fear it, too, is a remnant of the Company's passing.
'Go there, ${PLAYER}, and search for any items possibly left behind. It is clear that certain members of the Company are not as careful as they should be.
'If you find anything, return at once to me.'

This camp-site has been disturbed, and it appears something was taken. From the signs you have found, it would appear the ransackers were either Orcs or half-orcs.
Tracks lead away to the south. It appears that there are at least two half-orcs and one horse.
Golgallon will want to know about this.
'This is worse than I thought, ${PLAYER}. Whatever the Enemy found may disclose who the members of the Company are and put their quest in jeopardy....'
Search camp-site for signs of the Company's passing
Talk to Golgallon at Echad Eregion
Following the Path
Maedlathron sent you to the Elf-camp of Echad Eregion to warn Golgallon of the misfortunate signs of the Company's passing... only Golgallon was already aware of the signs.
'There is little time to lose, ${PLAYER}. Go to the camp-site I told you of and search there for signs of the Company's passing.'

The camp-site lies east and north of Echad Eregion, beyond Torech Bornagol and Torech Carangor.
Golgallon has asked you to search another camp-site for signs of the Company's passing.

Golgallon is at Echad Eregion, west and south of the camp-site, beyond Torech Carangor and Torech Bornagol.
You should return to Golgallon and warn him that the camp-site has been disturbed and something carried away.

'Hjór at your service and your family's! You look like just the sort able to help me with my troubles.
'My travelling companion, Thorlák, and I journeyed with Brogur's expedition. We had long debated the existence of the famed tower of Durin that some say sits atop Zirakzigil. I did not believe Thorlák when he said he would find it or perish in the attempt, but now I fear for his life!
'Four days ago, he left camp in search of Durin's Tower, and he has not been seen since. If you could journey into the Redhorn Gate and search for any sign of him, I would be much in your debt. I last saw Thorlák heading into the snow near to the mountains.'
The Redhorn-goat meat looks like it was skinned and cleaned by a skilled hand.
'A skinned goat? That is good news, for Thorlák might still be alive somewhere upon the mountain!'
Search for some sign of Thorlák
Talk to Hjór
A Fool's Hope
Hjór needs aid searching for his companion Thorlák upon Caradhras, which is called the Cruel.
'Thorlák was last seen on the lower slopes of the Redhorn Gate, near to the mountains heading into the snow.'
'Barazinbar is not called Caradhras the Cruel for nothing, you know.'

Thorlák headed into the Redhorn Gate, north-east of Echad Dúnann.
Hjór has asked that you search the Redhorn Gate for signs of Thorlák.

Hjór is at Echad Dúnann, south-west of the Redhorn Gate.
You should return to Hjór and tell him what you found in the Redhorn Gate.
Defeated fell holly-tenders (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Defeated Huorns (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, ${PLAYER}. Have you of late seen the holly-forest south of Gwingris? Huorns now walk about, attacking those who pass through the wood instead of remaining docile trees as they should.
'There is something amiss in the wood. Something has awakened the trees from their usual slumber and provokes them. The Huorns and holly-tenders are proving too great a threat so close to our way-post.
'Gather your friends, ${PLAYER}, and deal with this menace. Return to me when you are through, and perhaps we can learn what has stirred them.'

'It pains me to put these creatures of the forest to the sword, but the power of the Enemy has made it necessary. Against this corruption, there is little defence.
'It seems that our immediate concerns have been dealt with... let us hope that it stays that way. I fear there is more lurking beneath the surface, however.'
Defeat fell holly-tenders (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Defeat Huorns (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Lithuilas at Gwingris
A Foul Wood

Something foul twists the heart of the holly-forest south of Gwingris, corrupting the creatures which once dwelt there in peace.
You have been tasked with removing those holly-tenders and trees that have succumbed to the shadow and now attack those who pass through.
'Return to me when you have dealt with the Huorns and holly-tenders in Glâd Ereg to the south.'

Huorns, the great trees that move about freely, and holly-tenders can be found throughout Glâd Ereg.
Lithuilas has asked you to defeat the Huorns and holly-tenders which have been stirred to wrath. He recommends you take friends with you.

Lithuilas is at Gwingris, north of Glâd Ereg.
Lithuilas will want to know of your success.

'This is troubling news you bring me, ${PLAYER}. If what you say is true, then none of what has happened in Glâd Ereg is mere coincidence.
'It would seem that the Enemy is compelling all our foes against us in concert, not the least of which is Saruman the White. We must inform all of our allies and move to counter these threats at once.
'Journey south-east to the way-post of Echad Eregion and look for Faenhilith. She must know what we have learned.'

'Well met, friend. What news do you bring from Gwingris? Wood-trolls in Glâd Ereg?
'That is grave news indeed. We have seen more than our usual share of trouble lately, as well. It is a sign of these dark days, I fear.
'If you wish to aid us, speak with the other members of my company. We could use someone with your talents, I am sure.'
Talk to Faenhilith at Echad Eregion
Grasp of the White Hand
It appears that Saruman, too, has begun to twist and create wood-trolls. This troubling news must be delivered throughout Eregion.
'There is nothing more you can do here. Journey south-east to Echad Eregion and speak with Faenhilith.'

Faenhilith is at Echad Eregion, south-east of Gwingris.
Lithuilas suggested that you journey to Echad Eregion and speak with Faenhilith.
Defeated Dunlendings (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'While our resources have dwindled, our enemies have grown bolder. Dunlendings have established a lumber-camp to the south-east, just outside of Gwingris.
'There, they are butchering the wood to provide materials to the craftsmen of the traitor, Saruman the White. Their actions cannot go unchecked so close to our own way-post, ${PLAYER}.
'Head to the south-east and look for a small pond... our scouts report a large number of Dunlendings to be gathered there. Defeat as many of them as you can... they must be driven from this land.'
'Well done, ${PLAYER}. With the loss of so many of their labourers and guards, the Dunlendings should be thrown into disarray.'
Defeat Dunlendings south-east of Gwingris (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Inufileg at Gwingris
The Guards of Sâd Rechu
Dunlendings have established a lumber-camp in the wood of Sâd Rechu, where they collect wood for the use of Saruman's craftsmen.
'There is a small pond to the south-east of Gwingris. Focus your efforts there, then return to me when you have defeated the Dunlendings.'

Dunlendings can be found to the south-east of Gwingris.

'The leader of the shadow-wargs most likely stalks among them seeking for clues of the Company. I am certain you will find him upon the Burnt Tor.'

'You have returned, ${PLAYER}! Then the deed is done?
'An Orc? This is strange news, for if your description is true this is no Orc of Saruman, this is one of the foul Orcs of Mordor!
'Sauron's arm has grown long indeed... a report must be brought back to Rivendell.'

'Have you sought out the leader of the shadow-wargs, ${PLAYER}? He should stalk among his foul servants somewhere upon the Burnt Tor.'
'Hail, ${PLAYER}, Dagronk-bane!'

'I think perhaps we should try to disrupt their efforts by slaying the half-orcs who keep watch over the wolves. Without their guidance the wolves may turn aside from their task.
'Go to Barad Morlas, south-west of here, and hunt the wolf-keepers. You must not fail!'
'You have done well, ${PLAYER}, but I have another task for you, if you will hear me out....'

The Half-orcs' Beasts

'The burning of the Tor was the work of someone very powerful. If the Company was so pressed that they were forced to set such a blaze there will surely be other signs of the battle left upon the hilltop.
'Go and search for these signs and attempt to cover them as best you can. Be careful, ${PLAYER}, for I am sure that the threat of danger has not yet passed, and evil may yet lurk in the shadows of the Burnt Tor.'
'These are strange tokens, ${PLAYER}! I will keep them safe and deliver them to Master Elrond. He may be able to read the signs more clearly than I.'
'Have you found the remains of the battle upon the Burnt Tor?'
Talk to Ruidhriel
Collect the handkerchief
Collect the strange branch
Collect spent arrow
Hiding Their Passage
By examining the charred wood you brought her, Ruidhriel has discovered that a great battle took place upon the Burnt Tor.
'Speak nothing of what you have found upon the Burnt Tor, ${PLAYER}.'

Ruidhriel has asked you to find any remains of the battle that occurred upon the Burnt Tor and hide them.

Collected statues (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'${PLAYER}, I have a request to make of you that is of great importance to my people. As you are surely aware, Sauron long ago destroyed the realm of Eregion -- you can see it in these ruins upon which we now stand. Many of the survivors fled to the refuge of Imladris, where dwells Master Elrond.
'After the destruction of Eregion, some of our kindred returned and placed memorial statues at many locations where some of our bravest kinsmen fell. Now half-orcs have come to Barad Morlas and threaten to despoil our memorials.
'I ask that you go to Barad Morlas to the south-west and recover as many of the memorial statues as you can. While you are there, look also for a strange Orc who goes by the name of Shatogtar; defeat him, for it is he who commands the destruction of those things we hold dear.'
'Shatogtar is dead and the statues have been preserved? You have my deepest gratitude, ${PLAYER}.'
'You have been unable to retrieve the statues from Barad Morlas? What of Shatogtar? Does he yet live?'
Defeat Shatogtar
Collect statues (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Bring the statues to Ladenthir at Echad Eregion
Honouring the Fallen
After Sauron swept through Eregion of old, the Elves of Rivendell returned and placed statues at places where their brave kinsmen fell in battle.
'Barad Morlas lies just to the south-west. Please bring me those statues and drive forth Shatogtar from these lands.'

There are memorial statues spread all throughout Barad Morlas, south-west of Echad Eregion.
Ladenthir has asked you to preserve the memory of the Elves of Eregion by collecting the memorial statues placed in Barad Morlas by the Elves of Rivendell before the half-orcs can despoil them. He also bade you defeat Shatogtar, one of the Uruk-hai.

Ladenthir is at Echad Eregion, north-east of Barad Morlas.
You should return to Ladenthir with tidings of your success.
Collected tattered White Hand banners (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'We need to learn who leads the force at Barad Morlas. Until their leader is slain, the half-orcs will continue their efforts there, undaunted.
'Go to Barad Morlas, ${PLAYER}, and collect several of the banners the half-orcs have raised there. Amidst those tattered banners may be a clue as to the identity of their leader.
'The banners have been raised throughout Barad Morlas, south-west of here. Hurry now, ${PLAYER}...time is running short.'
'These banners will do nicely, ${PLAYER}. I should be able to learn the identity of the half-orcs' leaders with little difficulty.'
'Were you not able to find any banners at Barad Morlas, ${PLAYER}? I find that difficult to believe....'
Talk to Lengliel at Echad Eregion
Collect tattered White Hand banners (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Invader's Banners
You thinned the ranks of the half-orcs at Barad Morlas, but Lengliel warned you that would not be enough.

Tattered White Hand Banners can be found throughout the ruins of Barad Morlas, south-west of Echad Eregion. Lengliel is at Echad Eregion, north-east of Barad Morlas.

Defeated half-orcs at Barad Morlas (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'More half-orcs have come up from the South, ${PLAYER}, encamping at Barad Morlas, south-west of here. Whatever it is that Saruman seeks here, it cannot be for the benefit of the Free Peoples.
'It is said that Saruman is a master of craft, and it may be that he seeks that forbidden Art which was lost when Sauron destroyed Eregion. His minions must be driven forth before they can uncover any shred of that ancient knowledge.
'Go to Barad Morlas, ${PLAYER}, and thin the ranks of the half-orcs there. Perhaps that will dissuade them.'
'Thank you for your efforts, ${PLAYER}. You are certainly a valiant ${CLASS}, but there is much more to do there....'
Defeat half-orcs at Barad Morlas (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Lengliel at Echad Eregion
Invaders of Barad Morlas
Pembar is not the only Elf-ruin in Eregion to have been overrun. Barad Morlas in the south also has become a stronghold of Saruman's minions.
'There are half-orcs at Barad Morlas to the south-west, as well, ${PLAYER}. I fear we must deal with them as we did at Pembar.'

Defeated wood-trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'While you were dealing with our immediate concerns in Glâd Ereg, our scouts learned that there is a large presence of wood-trolls there as well. These creatures are bred by the Dark Lord and may well be the cause for the corruption of the forest.
'From what the scouts say, the wood-trolls dwell mainly in Sâd Thareg at the southern edge of Glâd Ereg. Go and see what you can learn of their presence there.
'Be wary and take an ally or two, for these monsters are terrible foes.'

'Well done, ${PLAYER}. Your efforts to curtail the advance of the wood-trolls may well save the forest from utter destruction.
'I can only hope that with the wood-trolls dealt with, the forest will soon know peace again.'
Defeat wood-trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Lithuilas at Gwingris
Keepers of the Wood
Lithuilas has learned that there is a group of wood-trolls in the Glâd Ereg and believes that they are responsible for provoking the forest.

Wood-trolls can be found near Sâd Thareg, south of Gwingris.

This axe was carried by a Dunlending, but you see markings that are clearly not of Dunlending-make. While you cannot tell the origin of the craftsmanship, perhaps one of the Elves in Gwingris will know more.

'This is strange. You say this was carried by one of the Dunlendings nearby?
'This axe is of a quality not normally known to these brigands and bodes ill. It seems that what would normally be an independent force has organized under someone else's banner.'
'Do you have something for me, ${PLAYER}?'
Bring the axe to Inufileg in Gwingris
A Labourer's Axe
You have found a strange axe on one of the Dunlendings near Gwingris, but you do not recognize the craftsmanship.

Gwingris is at the northern end of Glâd Ereg.
You should bring the axe to the Elves in Gwingris.

'It would appear that our work in Glâd Ereg is not yet complete. Our scouts report that there is a clear leader among the wood-trolls, and that he is organizing their foul efforts against the forest.
'This abomination must not be allowed to continue. The wood-trolls' leader must be destroyed. Gather your companions and venture south into the forest once more. There you will find the cave of Sâd Thareg, ${PLAYER}.
'Inside the cave are all manner of wood-trolls, no doubt. You will also find their leader, Zagâfum. Defeat the leader of the wood-trolls, then return to me when the task is done.'

'Excellent work, ${PLAYER}. Your efforts here will be remembered.
'Please tell me all that you have learned. I can only hope that we have rid ourselves of this menace once and for all.'
Defeat Zagâfum
Talk to Lithuilas at Gwingris
Leader of the Foul Wood
The leader of the wood-trolls has been discovered in Glâd Ereg. This may be an opportunity to end their threat in the holly-forest once and for all.

'Trolls, even wood-trolls, favour caves over the open air. Look for the cave of Sâd Thareg in Glâd Ereg to the south.
'It's possible the trolls have dug their own lair in the attempts to unsettle and corrupt the forest.'
'The Elves of Gwingris owe you a great debt of gratitude, ${PLAYER}. Thank you.'

'Though the Dunlendings were weakened by our assault, they have not departed from Eregion. Something else holds their will and drives their assaults.

'Return to Porth Cadlus and challenge this Uruk to single combat. If he is defeated, many of the Dunlendings will lay down arms and return to their homeland.'
'With their leader defeated, the Dunlendings will not continue their assault. You have our deepest thanks, ${PLAYER}.'
Use the horn of challenge to summon Gâmzhurm and defeat him

'The Dunlendings will soon be driven from Eregion, thanks to ${PLAYER}!'

'What do you bring to me?
'It is as I feared. Our latest delivery from Rivendell fell prey to the worms of Pend Eregion. We have long known of the worms; but until now they proved little more than a hinderance.

'Barad Morlas will be unaware that their messenger was unsuccessful in delivering his charge. I believe that now is the time to move against Porth Cadlus!
'The Dunlendings have already begun to muster their forces, but we will catch them unaware. Without aid, they will be unable to stand against our might.
'Go south and slightly west of Echad Dúnann, across Nan Sirannon, and begin the first assault against Porth Cadlus. Perhaps such a show of force will encourage them to return to their homes in Dunland.'
'The wild men of Dunland have been defeated? Maybe now they will realize they stand against a strong opposition, and will leave us in peace.'

'I did not wish for it to come to this, but the wild men have forced our hand.'

'All of our scouts upon Caradhras have reported strange sounds. The wind howls at them and laughs at their misfortunes. Stones seem to be hurled at them from the mountain-side. Storms rage at a moments notice, and wild beasts stalk hidden paths through the snow.
'Go and quell some of the tempests and defeat the beasts that stalk the mountain-side. I fear the storms are unnatural, for they seem guided by intent.
'The worst of the storms have been seen to the north-east in the Redhorn Gate.'
'You have returned! I feared that the ferocity of Caradhras might have gotten the best of you, but I can see you are a ${CLASS} of great skill.'
Defeat frost-grims (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Defeat snow-beasts (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Rostoriel at Echad Dúnann
Of Mountains and Tempers
Caradhras, called the Cruel, rages and throws terrible storms down upon the land.
'The worst of the storms have been seen north-east of Echad Dúnann in the Redhorn Gate.'
'Caradhras has no patience for the unsuspecting traveller.'

Frost-grims and snow-beasts have been seen in the Redhorn Gate, north-east of Echad Dúnann.
Rostoriel has asked you to quell the rage of Caradhras and defeat the beasts that dwell within the Redhorn Gate.

You should return to Rostoriel and tell her of your success.
An avalanche blocks the way
Look for signs of the Company

'Hail, stranger! It is good to see a friendly face in times such as these, but what brings you here?
'Rinneldor has sent aid as I had hoped! Caradhras is troubled; something has caused great unease upon his slopes. His winds are cold and biting, and I fear for any who have dared to tread upon him when he is in such a fey mood.
'I cannot leave my post, but perhaps you could travel to the mountain's lower slopes and <rgb=#FF0000>look</rgb> for signs of the Company? Travel north-east to the Redhorn Gate and look for any signs of them where the trees and snows meet.'

'An avalanche? We can only hope that the Company was not on the mountain when it happened.
'If they did brave the pass, no enemies will follow now. Thank you for your help, ${PLAYER}.'
Look for signs of the Company
Find the Redhorn Gate
Talk to Ruidhriel
Over the Pass of Caradhras
Rinneldor has asked you to seek out Ruidhriel who stands watch at the Redhorn Gate.
'Travel north-east into the Redhorn Gate and <rgb=#FF0000>look</rgb> for signs of the Company where the snow and trees meet.'
'Caradhras is no place for the unwary.'

The Redhorn Gate lies to the north-east of Ruidhriel's camp.
Ruidhriel has asked you to go up into the Redhorn Gate and <rgb=#FF0000>look</rgb> for signs of the Company where the snow and trees begin.

Ruidhriel is south and west of the Redhorn Gate, near the Burnt Tor.
You should return to Ruidhriel and tell her what you found.
Defeated worms (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, ${PLAYER}, and welcome to Gwingris.
'As you can see, our outpost is running low on supplies. I am afraid that the next shipment from Rivendell is long overdue, and that without those supplies, we will have a difficult time holding out against the forces of the Enemy.
'Prior deliveries have met with trouble in the valley to the east of here in the form of worms. If you could take the time to thin their numbers in the valley, our efforts to resupply will proceed more smoothly in the future.'

'Well done, ${PLAYER}. I think that should thin their numbers enough for our supplies to make it through unharmed for the near future.
'There is still more that can be done, however.'
Defeat worms (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Daegennan at Gwingris
The Path From Rivendell
Vile worms threaten the routes from Rivendell to the Elf-waypost at Gwingris.
'Deliveries made in the past from Rivendell often speak of worms that dwell in the valley far to the east of here. Begin your hunt there.'

Worms can be found in the valleys east of Gwingris.
Daegennan has asked you to help clear the routes between Rivendell and Gwingris of worms.

Daegennan is at Gwingris, west of the worm-valleys.
You should return to Daegennan in Gwingris.
Defeated half-orcs at Pembar (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'${PLAYER}, we are in need of your aid. To the north-east, in the ruins of Pembar, my scouts have followed the arrival of half-orcs from Isengard. What their exact purpose is, we do not know, but the scouts have also seen many worm-eggs in that place.
'Perhaps if you thin the numbers of the half-orcs, you will find some clue as to their purpose. They are newly come to Pembar, but they have come in strength.
'When you have performed this deed, return to me, and we will continue our discussion.'

'So the number of the worm-eggs was much greater than we first believed. And what is more, the half-orcs do not seem concerned by them.
'I fear they are part of Saruman's plans. We shall have to deal with this threat at once!'
Defeat half-orcs at Pembar (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Talk to Lengliel at Echad Eregion
Pembar's Unwelcome Visitors

The ancient Elf-ruins of Pembar have been overrun by half-orcs in the service of Saruman. What they may be seeking there is as of yet unknown, though the worm-eggs seen there by Lengliel's scouts are quite disturbing.
'Go to Pembar, north-east of here, ${PLAYER}, and defeat the minions of Saruman the White.

Half-orcs can be found in Pembar, north-east of Echad Eregion.

'Return south to the forest and look for clear spaces where these trees will have sufficient room to grow. I am sure such clearings might be found throughout Glâd Ereg, look to the light to guide you.
'When you have completed your task, return to me, and we will discuss your reward.'

'We have done what we may. Now it is up to the forest to bring forth its young.
'Thank you for your aid, ${PLAYER}.'
'Have you planted all the seeds yet?'

Talk to Celebrandir at Gwingris
Planting Anew
Celebrandir was pleased with the seeds that were brought to him, for they gave him hope that the wood may yet be renewed.
'${PLAYER}, be sure to look for clear areas where the seeds will be able to grow unimpeded.'
'The forest would never recover if it were not for your efforts, ${PLAYER}. Thank you for all your aid.'

There are clearings throughout Glâd Ereg, the forest south of Gwingris.
Celebrandir instructed you to plant the seeds in clear spaces where the trees will have room to grow.

'The messenger must be stopped, ${PLAYER}. If Barad Morlas receives reinforcements, they may have enough strength to break our defences and rout the Free Peoples in Eregion.
'The messenger was last seen west of Porth Cadlus, south-west of Echad Dúnann, across Nan Sirannon. You must be quick if you are to stop him before he reaches their camp.'
'The messenger has been dispatched? Now we need not fear the Dunlending axes of Nan Sirannon coming to the aid of Barad Morlas!'
Defeat the messenger
Talk to Glavroleth at Echad Dúnann
A Plea From Barad Morlas
A messenger has been dispatched from Barad Morlas seeking aid from the Dunlendings encamped in Eregion.
'The messenger was last seen west of Porth Cadlus, south-west of Echad Dúnann, across Nan Sirannon.'
'We must take counsel against the Dunlendings, ${PLAYER}.'

The Messenger is west of Porth Cadlus, south-west of Echad Dúnann and across Nan Sirannon.
You must stop the Dunlanding Messenger from receiving reinforcements from Nan Sirannon.

'The storms have not relented. The winds continue to howl, and I can hear anger in the voice of Caradhras, but not for the Elves or even the dwarves. There is something on the mountain that is causing his fury.
'It will be a dangerous task, but I would ask that you search as high into the pass as you dare and seek out the source of the mountain's anger. Only by soothing the wrath of Caradhras will we be able to safely continue our search for signs of the Company.
'You should return to the Redhorn Gate, north-east of here, and search the highest reaches of the mountain-side.'

'A camp-fire? And so high into the pass!
'This must have been left by the Company, but did they brave the Redhorn Gate or were they forced off Caradhras by his fury...?'
'Have you found the source of Caradhras' fury?'
Talk to Rostoriel at Echad Dúnann

Quelling the Storm

'The camp-fire explains the strange signs Master Elrond sensed upon Caradhras.'

Rostoriel has asked you to search the highest reaches of the Redhorn Gate for clues to understand the mountain's anger.

'${PLAYER}, my friend, you have done a great service for the Elves, and I would ask one more favour of you. Go to Echad Dúnann and speak with Palanaer. He should know of Saruman's encroachment upon the ruins of Eregion.
'Echad Dúnann lies to the south-east, not far from the gates of Moria called the Doors of Durin. Go, and may the stars shine upon your road.'

'Welcome, ${PLAYER}. You bring word from Ladenthir? It troubles me that Saruman's forces have moved so far north, and that he dares to despoil the ancient ruins of our kinsmen.
'Though your news is dire, I thank you for it, for it will allow us to prepare a defence.'
Talk to Palanaer at Echad Dúnann
Reach of the White Hand
Ladenthir does not know how far the reach of Saruman has gone, but his touch has been felt in Eregion.
'Go now to Echad Dúnann...Palanaer should know of Saruman's encroachment.'

Palanaer is at Echad Dúnann, south-east of Echad Eregion.
Ladenthir has asked you to bear news of Saruman's encroachment upon Eregion to Palanaer, another of the scouts of Rivendell.
Collected Elf-relics (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collected Elf-trinkets (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'${PLAYER}, it is vital that these half-orcs do not bring their bounty to Saruman the White. There is no telling what mischief a Wizard might put the relics of the Elves to.
'Go to Pembar, my friend. Defeat the half-orcs and wrest from them any relics or trinkets you may find. They cannot be allowed to fulfil their task.
'Pembar lies to the north-east, if the direction eludes you.'
'Thank you, ${PLAYER}, for bringing these things to me. The half-orcs uncovered many whole relics and trinkets which might have been put to ill use by Saruman.'
'Have you been unable to recover any relics and trinkets from the half-orcs at Pembar? Alas, that is ill news. Will you not try again, ${PLAYER}?'
Bring relics to Faenhilith

Pembar's Relics
Your examination of the rubble at Pembar yielded some relic-fragments, which concern Faenhilith greatly.

Collected crates (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'With one delivery lost and the worms on the rise, we have need of your help.
'It is unlikely that all of the delivery is completely lost. If you find any more goods from this delivery, please bring them back to me.
'I believe that you will find more of the supplies along the road from Rivendell, well to the east.'

'Greetings, ${PLAYER}. I and my companions are recently come from Rivendell at the behest of Master Elrond. He fears that spies of the Enemy may dog the footsteps of the Company which left Imladris some little while ago -- the Company which bears a heavy burden -- and commanded us to follow in their wake, lest some sign of their passing be left behind.
'To this end, many of my companions have gone forth to scout the lands. It is clear that Aragorn son of Arathorn journeys with the Company still, for there has been little of note to see. They have lit few fires, for fear of the Enemy, which is good; however, one of my scouts reports that he saw signs of an old camp-fire south-east of here.
'If you would, seek out that camp and learn if any other sign has been left behind which may reveal the composition of the Company. The camp-site lies far to the south-east, beyond Sâd Rechu, nestled at the base of some boulders.'

'You say you found this pouch at the camp-site? It contains some small portion of the halfling's pipe-weed.
'It may be that one of the halflings or the dwarf dropped this. Such carelessness could be their undoing.'
'Go to the camp-site to the south-east of here and search for any sign of the Company's passing. If you find anything, remove it before the Enemy descends upon the camp.'
Scour the company's path

Scouring the Path

After some time passed, Elrond Halfelven sent scouts into the fields of Eregion to follow the path of the Company which left Rivendell and make sure that no signs of their passing remained for the Enemy to find.
'Go to the camp-site to the south-east of here and search for any sign of the Company's passing. If you find anything, remove it before the Enemy descends upon the camp.'

The camp-site is nestled at the base of some large boulders, some distance to the south-east of Gwingris, beyond Sâd Rechu, south of the road to Pembar.

'I am afraid that your efforts to the south will not be enough to repel the corruption the Enemy has brought to Glâd Ereg. The evil has gone far too deep.
'In order to repair the damage that our enemies have brought about, we will need to replant the holly-trees that have been devastated by the trolls and their foul ways.
'Journey south into the forest and find holly-seeds from the bushes that grow beneath the trees there. Bring them to me, and we will still find the opportunity to ensure the forest's prosperity.'
'These seeds are the hope of the forest, ${PLAYER}. I thank you, for your efforts could very well make the difference in the future of Glâd Ereg.'
'Were you not able to collect enough seeds, ${PLAYER}?'
Collect seeds (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Bring the seeds to Celebrandir at Gwingris
Seeds for the Future
The corruption that has struck Glâd Ereg and the destruction wreaked by the minions of the Enemy have ruined many a wood.
'You can find holly-seeds in the bushes that grow in under the trees south of Gwingris. Bring me as many as you can, and perhaps we can heal the forest.'

Holly-seeds can be found on the bushes growing underneath the trees in Glâd Ereg, south of Gwingris.

Celebrandir is awaiting the seeds you collected.

'A short while ago, as the Elves would recount it, a copse of ancient trees stood here, but it seems that strange deeds have taken place that I cannot yet explain.
'Something has happened upon the hilltop. I fear that the Company may have encountered a powerful enemy; even the smallest clue could bring disastrous news to our enemies.
'You must go and collect some of the charred remains and bring them here for me to study. You will find the charred wood lying upon the ground throughout the Burnt Tor.'
'It is as I feared: this wood was not burned by natural means. A word of command was used to light the fire that kindled this wood.'
'Have you found the charred wood yet, ${PLAYER}? I am sure that it can be found in abundance upon the Burnt Tor behind me.'

'They must be reporting to someone in Eregion. Go north and east, up the winding roads into the Redhorn Gate, and search out this spy-master. Once he has been dealt with, maybe we will have some peace, and the skies will no longer bear the unceasing sound of crow-wings.'

'There are only three paths that seem reasonable for their passage across the Mountains: through the pass of the Redhorn Gate, south through the Gap of Rohan... or beneath the Mountains through the halls of Moria. Speak with our scouts, Ruidhriel and Limlaer, and learn if they have noted aught of the Company's passing.
'Ruidhriel is encamped near a place to the north-west which we are calling the Burnt Tor, for something has scorched the earth there. Limlaer may be found along the road, south-west of here.'

'So, the Company tried the Redhorn Gate, but was foiled by Caradhras itself. And no sign was found of their passing through the Gap of Rohan? The latter does not surprise me, for it would bring their burden very near to the traitor Saruman, and that would be disastrous.

'Many of the Elves of Echad Dúnann have seen a pony wandering among the hills; it seemed an odd place for such a beast, and a wonder that it survived with such great peril close at hand.
'I went myself in search of the pony, and when I caught sight of it, I immediately recognized the animal: it was the pony that the halfling, Samwise Gamgee, had kept stabled in Imladris.
'He had a wild look and had no bit or bridle. The pony was quite wary, but seemed in good health. I last saw him beyond the hills, west of Echad Dúnann in Torech Andraug. Go and see if you can clear a path for the pony to come back safely; the wild is no place for such a beast to roam by himself.'

You have found none other than Bill, the loyal little steed of Sam Gamgee.

'While your efforts against the wolf-keepers at Barad Morlas have certainly hindered the plans of the White Hand, they have not halted their search. They are driven by the chief of their keepers, a creature who goes by the name of Nûkhud, Wolf-master.
'I would have you return to Barad Morlas and defeat Nûkhud. His defeat should drive fear into the hearts of the half-orcs and their wolf allies.
'Nûkhud was last seen ranging beyond the ruins west of the bridge in Barad Morlas, south-west of here. Be careful, ${PLAYER}... he is certain to be a dangerous foe.'
'Ha! Nûkhud's demise should give the half-orcs pause! Well done, ${PLAYER}.'
Defeat Nûkhud, Wolf-master
Talk to Dornhador at Echad Eregion

'Nûkhud's defeat should drive terror into the hearts of the half-orcs at Barad Morlas. Go now and see to his demise.'
'The wolves of Saruman will learn to fear us, thanks to you!'

Nûkhud, Wolf-master is at Barad Morlas, south-west of Echad Eregion.

Defeated Arzgât and collected note

'You have dealt with the half-orc rabble here in northern Eregion, ${PLAYER}, but their true purpose is only beginning to become clear.
'Recently, our scouts have indicated that a half-orc with some skill in training the worms is attempting to bend the vile beasts to his will. If he succeeds, he could build a terrible army in Eregion.
'Return to the east and look for a small range of mountains south of the road to Rivendell. Among them is Carchres. If you find Arzgât there, put an end to his vile ambitions.'
'Arzgât has perished? That is welcome news, ${PLAYER}. Perhaps the evil he has wrought will soon come to an end.'
'Arzgât was last seen on the northern side of a small range of mountains to the east, just south of the road to Rivendell.'

The egg-stealing half-orcs are being overseen by a particularly vicious creature named Arzgât.
